jobs.title: Security Operations Analyst (SIEM Operations and Threat Detection)
jobs.excerpt: We are looking to join a Senior consultant within the Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC), a globally distributed team of cybersecurity professionals responsible for protecting complex and diverse technology environments.
jobs.description:
We are looking to join a Senior consultant within the Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC), a globally distributed team of cybersecurity professionals responsible for protecting complex and diverse technology environments.

The role is primarily focused on enhancing threat detection and cybersecurity operations capabilities through activities such as security content management, quality assurance and validation of detection mechanisms, detection use case lifecycle management, onboarding and integration of new security data sources, reporting, and process optimization.

This is an excellent opportunity for professionals interested in working within a large-scale international cybersecurity environment, where they will play a key role in the continuous improvement of security monitoring and threat detection services across multiple customer landscapes. The position combines elements of Security Operations, Threat Detection Engineering, SIEM optimization, cyber risk management, and operational excellence, offering exposure to a wide variety of cybersecurity technologies and challenges.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the development, implementation, validation, tuning, and maintenance of security monitoring, analytics, and detection capabilities across SIEM, EDR, cloud, and other cybersecurity platforms.
  • Support the operation, maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of security monitoring and threat detection services.
  • Participate in the onboarding, integration, testing, and validation of security data sources, telemetry feeds, and monitoring capabilities.
  • Contribute to security content management activities, including use case lifecycle management, rule reviews, testing, tuning, and content quality assurance.
  • Collaborate with cyber threat intelligence, incident response, and cybersecurity operations teams to translate operational and threat intelligence requirements into effective detection and monitoring capabilities.
  • Under guidance, participate in cybersecurity architecture reviews of new or existing solutions and provide recommendations to enhance security monitoring and detection effectiveness.
  • Contribute to the preparation and maintenance of cybersecurity operations metrics, dashboards, KPIs, and service performance reports.
  • Review, validate, and assess the effectiveness of detections, monitoring configurations, operational processes, and service deliverables, identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Gather and analyze operational feedback to identify opportunities for tuning, optimization, reduction of false positives, and improvement of overall detection quality.
  • Contribute to quality assurance activities, including process reviews, control validation, service quality assessments, and implementation of corrective actions.
  • Support the development, review, and maintenance of CSOC procedures, standards, documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational guidance materials.
  • Prepare and present technical reports, summaries, findings, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.

On-Call Availability (On-Call Shift System)

  • Mandatory 24/7 On-Call Rotation: You will be required to participate in a rotating on-call shift schedule from Monday to Sunday.

  • What this means: This does not mean you will be actively working 24/7 or during late-night shifts. Instead, you will be on standby outside of standard working hours, meaning you must be reachable and available to log in and resolve critical system incidents only if they arise.

  • Frequency: The approximate rotation frequency is one full week (7 consecutive days) every X months, depending on the number of team members

Must have:

  • +5 years of relevant experience in information technology field, including triage of alerts and supporting security incidents
  • Proven experience on administering a SIEM platform, preferably either Splunk or MicrosoftSentinel SIEM
  • Proven experience with the usual toolbox available in a SOC (e.g., SIEMs, EDRs) and being able to autonomously perform technical analysis of security threats and collaborate with Incident Response team
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Security Tools (e.g. M365, Cloud App Security, Azure,Defender for Endpoints, Azure Security, Azure Sentinel and XDR)
  • Deep Knowledge of Cloud technologies (e.g. Azure, AWS and GCP)
  • Deep knowledge of SIEM tools like Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, MS Sentinel, ELK Stac
  • Knowledge of at least one EDR solution (MS Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike)
  • Knowledge of email security, network monitoring, and incident response
  • Knowledge of Linux/Mac/Windows
  • C1 English proficiency

Nice to have:

  • Experience in building SIEM architectures from initial design to implementation, including designing data ingestion pipelines for diverse log sources across cloud and on-prem environments
  • Proven knowledge of monitoring AWS environment (Iaas, Saas, Paas)
  • Knowledge of at least one general-purpose or shell scripting language (e.g. Ruby, Bash, PowerShell, Python, etc.)

Desirable certifications:

  • MCSE, CCNA, Microsoft Azure (e.g., SC-200), GCIH, CEH, GCFA or any GIAC/similar certification

Required Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills
  • Customer-facing experience and oral communication skills
  • Ability to write documentation & reports
  • Creativity/ ability to find innovative solutions
  • Willingness to learn on the job
  • Conflict management & cooperation

What do we offer you?

  • Remote Position
  • Freelance, full-time contract.
  • Training and career development.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you!

jobs.excerpt: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £138,000 to £176,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +benefits | Hear from the team ✨

About the role

Borrowing is one of Monzo’s most important growth engines. We’ve built strong scale in the UK, and the next phase is even more ambitious: grow in the UK, expand into new customer segments, and build the underwriting capability needed to scale into Europe.

We’re looking for a senior ML leader to help shape that next phase.

You’ll lead a high-calibre team of ML scientists and help define Borrowing’s ML roadmap across UK growth, new customer segments, and EU expansion. You’ll work across underwriting, pricing, limits, and lifecycle decisioning — improving today’s models while helping build the next generation of capability for Monzo.

This role combines near-term commercial impact with long-term strategic advantage:

  • improving performance across our range of products
  • unlocking new data and faster model development
  • helping Monzo build underwriting that scales into new markets
  • shaping how advanced ML and AI can create real value in Borrowing

You’ll partner closely with leaders across Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, Model Validation, Data, and Platform, and influence decisions that shape both business performance and the long-term architecture of credit decisioning at Monzo.

What you’ll own

  • Borrowing ML roadmaps across UK optimisation, new customer segments, and EU expansion
  • Faster model improvement through new data and feature engineering
  • How Monzo uses Open Banking, transaction intelligence, and external data in credit decisioning
  • More portable underwriting capabilities across products, customer segments, and markets
  • Hiring, leading, and developing a high-performing ML team
  • Raising the bar on model quality, governance, tooling, and speed of iteration

What you’ll be working on

Examples of the challenges you could help lead:

  • Improving underwriting models across Loans, Flex, and Overdrafts
  • Expand the data we use in our models
  • Building better feature engineering and model shipping capability
  • Improving transaction intelligence for credit use cases
  • Developing underwriting capabilities for new customer segments and EU markets
  • Shaping Monzo’s approach to advanced ML and AI

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies, although we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all of them:

  • Google Cloud Platform
  • BigQuery SQL and dbt
  • Python and the PyData stack
  • Google AI Platform
  • AWS
  • Python for ML services
  • Go for backend services
  • AI tooling for productivity
  • Google Workspace including Gemini
  • ChatGPT Enterprise
  • Claude Code

You should apply if

  • You want to shape the next phase of credit decisioning at one of Europe’s most ambitious fintechs
  • You enjoy combining strategic leadership with strong technical judgment
  • You’re excited by the intersection of underwriting, data, product, and platform capability
  • You like building teams as much as building models
  • You care about real customer and business impact

You must have

Credit and machine learning

  • Strong knowledge of machine learning, statistics, and decisioning systems
  • Deep experience in credit risk and lending
  • Experience building, deploying, and iterating credit models in production
  • Experience pushing the innovation frontiers of the credit industry

Leadership and delivery

  • Experience leading and developing senior ML scientists
  • Strong cross-functional leadership with Product, Credit Strategy, Engineering, and Validation
  • Track record of turning strategy into practical delivery in a regulated environment

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience across more than one market
  • Experience with advanced ML methods and AI on structured financial data

The interview process

  • 30 min Recruiter Call
  • 45 min Initial Call
  • 60 min ML technical interview
  • 60 min People Leadership interview
  • 60 min Product / Credit ML interview

All interviews will be conducted through Google Meet.

What’s in it for you

💰 £138,000 to £176,000 ➕ plus stock options & benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office with a hybrid working pattern, or fully remote within the UK with occasional travel to London.

🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home, including support for remote setups.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work in a way that lets you do your best work.

📚 Learning budget for books, training courses and conferences

➕ And much more — see our full list of benefits here

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

Who We Are:

Lumelight is an integrated workplace administration and compliance business. We serve the brokers and third party administrators who support employers in the complex, crucial areas of benefits design, compliance and administration. We handle the complexities of benefits compliance and administration, empowering you to focus on what you do best.

As the thoughtful synthesis of carefully curated specialists, Lumelight was created to serve a highly fragmented market by simplifying benefits compliance, reducing exposure to risk and giving clients the freedom and confidence to focus on their core business and accelerate performance.

We are looking for an experienced employee benefits health & welfare compliance consultant to join our team. The Compliance Consultant helps clients – including employers, brokers, TPAs and PBMs – navigate and interpret federal and state regulatory requirements for employer-sponsored benefit plans (e.g., medical, dental, vision, and life).

Our compliance professionals stay current on evolving regulations and translate complex rules into practical, actionable guidance. We specialize in compliance requirements for employer-sponsored benefits under ERISA, COBRA, ACA, §125, MHPAEA, HIPAA and related federal and state requirements.

This is a remote position with occasional travel for client trainings, conferences, or team meetings. If you excel at solving complex benefit compliance challenges and communicating clearly to diverse audiences, we’d love to hear from you.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Build productive, trusted relationships with clients nationwide
  • Provide expert health & welfare benefits compliance guidance
    • Handle 12-15 compliance questions daily via our helpline (via phone or email), ensuring a consistent 24-hour turnaround
    • Develop and present webinars, live trainings and seminars month
    • Compose timely compliance articles on a bi-weekly basis
  • Develop content for compliance-related tools and resources
  • Monitor legislation, regulations, and guidance to stay ahead of industry changes
  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert and support product development
  • Mentor and coach colleagues to strengthen team expertise and capacity
  • Collaborate to improve team workflows, processes, and client-facing deliverables
  • Travel occasionally for client presentations, conferences, or internal team events (estimated approximately 2-3 times per year)

Requirements and Desired Qualifications

  • 2-5+ years of experience in employee benefits compliance consulting, mastery level experience with IRS, DOL and CMS regulations
  • Juris Doctorate (JD) preferred
  • Knowledge of ERISA, COBRA, ACA, §125, MHPAEA, HIPAA and related rules
  • Ability to distill complex federal and state regulatory information into clear written and verbal guidance
  • Strong consulting, analytical and business acumen
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills
  • Demonstrated customer-service orientation
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience with compliance research tools (e.g., Thomson Reuter’s EBIA Checkpoint Library & Westlaw Advantage)

This position is a remote position within approved Lumelight states. This job operates in a professional office environment, whether in person or remotely. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and printers.Equipment will be provided to you.

  • 401(k) with Automatic Company Contribution
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off

jobs.excerpt: ROLE TITLECommercial Property Manager VAWe are looking for Virtual Professionals based in the Philippines.
jobs.description:
ROLE TITLE

Commercial Property Manager VA

We are looking for Virtual Professionals based in the Philippines.

  • This is a fully remote Commercial Property Manager VA position.
  • Applications with an introduction video attached will be prioritized.
  • Due to the fully remote nature of this role, it is important that candidates are comfortable communicating on video calls.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Commercial Property Manager VA supports the day-to-day operations of a commercial property in Indianapolis, keeping leasing, tenant requests, maintenance, property information, and documentation moving without constant supervision.

You will manage multiple active workflows at once, including prospective tenant and application activity, lease paperwork, move-ins and move-outs, maintenance requests, vacancy updates, floor plan changes, tenant concerns, events, and property documents. The role requires consistent follow-through: identifying what needs to happen next, gathering missing information, coordinating with tenants, vendors, architects, and the property team, and tracking each item through completion.

This is an execution-heavy role for someone who can work independently, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions about when to act, when to follow up, and when to escalate. You should not need a daily task list to stay productive or wait for someone else to tell you the next step.

If you are strongest in narrowly defined administrative tasks and require frequent direction to move work forward, this role is not a fit.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Property Marketing and Vacancy Updates

• Keep commercial vacancies current on LoopNet MLS, including unit status, availability, renovations, and other relevant property information.

• Coordinate with the current architect when floor plans need to be updated because of changes to the property or individual units.

• Maintain accurate unit information across property marketing materials and internal records so vacancy information does not become outdated.

• Eventually take ownership of updating floor plans using AutoCAD or another floor plan editing tool.

Leasing Support

• Support the screening of new rental applications by gathering, organizing, and reviewing the required information before moving the application to the next step.

• Communicate with prospective tenants and applicants throughout the leasing process and respond to questions or missing information promptly.

• Assist with preparing lease documents and associated paperwork, ensuring required information is complete and organized.

• Coordinate lease signings and follow up on outstanding documentation rather than allowing paperwork to stall.

• Coordinate move-in and move-out processes and ensure the necessary information, documents, and follow-ups are completed.

• Support lease renewal activity by tracking upcoming renewals and coordinating the required next steps.

Maintenance and Work Order Management

• When a tenant reports a maintenance issue, gather enough information to understand what is happening, determine the appropriate next step, and avoid sending incomplete information to Jennifer or a vendor.

• Coordinate with internal team and vendors when repairs or maintenance are required.

• Track open maintenance requests through completion and follow up when a vendor response, update, or repair is delayed.

• Keep work order information current so the team can see what has been reported, who is handling it, what action is pending, and whether the issue has been resolved.

• Escalate issues when the available information is insufficient, the situation requires a decision outside your authority, or progress has stalled.

Document Control

• Develop and maintain standardized formats for forms and documents used across the organization.

• Apply consistent document layouts, fonts, formatting, and other readability standards rather than creating documents with inconsistent presentation.

• Keep documents organized and accessible so the correct version can be located without unnecessary back-and-forth.

• Manage multiple documents simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

Tenant Concierge

• Respond to tenant and guest requests involving common areas, events, Wi-Fi access, and building access.

• Determine what information or action is required for each request and coordinate with the appropriate person or vendor when the request cannot be resolved directly.

• Plan, organize, and coordinate building events, including vendor coordination and space setup.

• Ensure events and tenant activities follow applicable building rules and requirements.

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

• Proven work experience in property management, with the ability to handle actual property-management workflows rather than only general administrative support.

• Strong written and verbal English communication. You will communicate with tenants, applicants, vendors, architects, and internal stakeholders, so unclear or incomplete communication creates operational problems.

• Excellent proficiency in AppFolio.

• Ability to manage multiple active property-management tasks and documents at the same time without losing track of follow-ups.

• Strong problem-solving ability. When a tenant reports an issue, you must be able to gather the relevant facts, identify the next action, and escalate appropriately instead of simply forwarding the complaint.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly when maintaining vacancy information, lease documentation, work orders, tenant records, and standardized documents.

• Ability to work independently in a remote, async environment and make routine execution decisions without requiring constant supervision.

We are transforming our development model to focus on building custom, user-centric solutions—and seeking candidates who thrive in creating innovative, high-impact software. As an early member of this evolving model, you will directly influence our technical architecture, development operations, and long-term engineering strategy.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Business Systems Manager to own the intent layer of our systems roadmap and help stand up the infrastructure that lets us build fast without breaking things — turning ambiguous business asks into structured, buildable specs, and partnering with our Business Systems Software Engineer and platform admins on the DevOps, data quality, and context work behind every release. You'll be a core part of modernizing Neat's quoting, dynamic pricing, and subscription management systems.

Responsibilities

  • Own the business systems intake process, triaging requests from cross-functional stakeholders (Sales Ops, Finance, Channel, Product, Marketing) into a structured, prioritized backlog.

  • Lead agile delivery — sprint planning, backlog grooming, and UAT — translating operational asks into user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria.

  • Partner with the Business Systems Software Engineer to stand up the infrastructure and DevOps practices — environments, deployment pipelines, testing and rollback — that let a small team ship fast without breaking production.

  • Own data quality across our core systems: audit, clean, and put ongoing checks in place so bad data doesn't undermine automation, reporting, or customer-facing systems.

  • Build and maintain the context libraries that keep the knowledge our engineering work builds from accurate and current.

  • Work day-to-day with the broader Business Systems team — our Salesforce and NetSuite/Celigo admins — to route requests to the right owner, diagnose root cause when data integrity breaks, and confirm specs are grounded in what the platforms can actually do.

  • Translate business asks into specs precise enough that the Business Systems Software Engineer can execute without renegotiating scope mid-build, and sanity-check architecture and data-flow decisions rather than rubber-stamp them.

  • Balance shipping a fast MVP against the long-term roadmap — know when a manual workaround is fine for now and when it isn't.

  • Real, hands-on experience shipping production work with AI development tools — not someone who's only experimented with them.

  • Working knowledge of subscription/entitlement mechanics — proration, true-forward reconciliation, co-terming — enough to spec requirements and sanity-check engineering work.

Position Summary

Ironmark is seeking a strategic, analytical, and client-focused Senior Digital Marketing Strategist to lead integrated marketing strategy across a portfolio of client accounts.

This role serves as the strategic bridge between client business objectives and marketing execution, partnering with clients, account teams, and channel specialists to develop growth-focused strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. The Senior Digital Marketing Strategist is responsible for aligning marketing initiatives across the customer journey, translating performance data into actionable recommendations, and ensuring execution supports broader business goals.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, marketing expertise, and analytical thinking with the ability to build trusted client relationships and influence cross-functional teams. This role does not directly manage personnel but plays a critical leadership role in shaping strategy, guiding execution, and driving client success.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor for assigned client accounts.
  • Lead strategic planning initiatives, quarterly business reviews, growth discussions, and client consultations.
  • Translate business goals into integrated marketing strategies and actionable roadmaps.
  • Present strategic recommendations, performance insights, and growth opportunities to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships through proactive consultation and strategic guidance.

Integrated Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and oversee integrated marketing strategies across paid media, SEO, AEO, content marketing, email marketing, local marketing, analytics, and emerging digital channels.
  • Ensure channel initiatives work cohesively throughout the customer journey and support business objectives.
  • Collaborate with channel specialists to align tactical execution with strategic priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance through audience targeting, conversion optimization, content alignment, media mix adjustments, and cross-channel coordination.
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies, AI-driven search experiences, and evolving consumer behavior.

Performance & Growth Planning

  • Analyze marketing performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and growth drivers.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Develop testing roadmaps and optimization plans designed to improve business outcomes.
  • Recommend channel investment strategies and budget allocation.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth and expanded service adoption.
  • Lead strategic onboarding and discovery efforts for new client engagements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Paid Media, SEO, Content, Creative, Analytics, Development, Local Marketing, and Account Management teams to ensure coordinated execution.
  • Provide strategic guidance while respecting channel ownership and subject matter expertise.
  • Support internal teams with market research, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations.
  • Contribute to agency thought leadership, process improvements, and strategic best practices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4–7 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, account strategy, marketing consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experience presenting recommendations and performance insights to clients or business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of integrated digital marketing strategy and how multiple channels work together to drive business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated expertise in multiple digital marketing disciplines and working knowledge across paid, organic, content, local, email, and analytics channels.
  • Experience analyzing marketing performance data and translating insights into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred

  • Agency experience managing multiple client accounts.
  • Experience supporting multi-location, healthcare, multifamily, higher education, franchise, or B2B marketing programs.
  • Familiarity with GA4, Looker Studio, CRM platforms, marketing automation platforms, and reporting tools.
  • Understanding of AI-powered search experiences, AEO, attribution frameworks, and conversion optimization.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You naturally connect business goals to marketing strategy.
  • You enjoy solving complex marketing challenges and uncovering growth opportunities.
  • You can confidently communicate with clients, executives, and channel specialists.
  • You think beyond individual tactics and understand how channels work together throughout the customer journey.
  • You are comfortable using data to inform decisions and recommendations.
  • You balance strategic thinking with accountability and execution.
  • You stay curious about emerging trends in AI, search, media, and digital marketing.

Why Join Ironmark

At Ironmark, we combine strategy, creativity, technology, and data to help organizations grow. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and delivering measurable results for clients across a wide range of industries.

As a Senior Digital Marketing Strategist, you’ll have the opportunity to influence meaningful client outcomes, collaborate with talented specialists, and help shape the future of integrated digital marketing.

We are seeking a highly skilled Corporate Counsel with 5-7 years of corporate experience to serve as the senior-most legal, compliance, and privacy authority at Wellspring Worldwide. This role combines the responsibilities of Corporate Counsel—owning the full spectrum of legal risk, regulatory compliance, and privacy across the company's global operations. In these roles you will partner with our CTO who is our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) The ideal candidate will leverage AI-powered legal tools to drive efficiency and scalability, while advising executive leadership as a trusted strategic partner.

This role carries direct ownership of three functional areas:

  • Legal strategy, contracts, M&A, litigation, IP, corporate governance, and international expansion.
  • Regulatory compliance, internal controls, and security policy frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Legal Compliance & Risk Management

ContractReview andManagement

Corporate Governance

Regulatory Affairs Responsibilities

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer (CPO)
jobs.excerpt: About Allia Health GroupAllia Health Group (AHG) is building a vertically integrated digital health platform — connecting compounding pharmacy, women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record, and an AI-and-data infrastructure layer into a single, coordinated patient experience.
jobs.description:
About Allia Health Group

Allia Health Group (AHG) is building a vertically integrated digital health platform — connecting compounding pharmacy, women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record, and an AI-and-data infrastructure layer into a single, coordinated patient experience. Our portfolio spans a 503A compounding pharmacy, two direct-to-consumer telehealth brands, and a provider-network EHR launching in 2026, all sharing a common goal: deliver personalized, outcomes-driven care beyond the limits of the traditional healthcare model.

We are assembling a senior leadership team to scale that platform. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to define and lead the product strategy that turns a collection of strong businesses into one connected, durable healthcare system.

The Opportunity

This is AHG's first dedicated product executive. You will build and lead the product discipline across the company: what we build, for whom, why, and in what order — across every brand and surface. That means consumer direct-to-consumer subscription products in women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record launching this year, a clinical layer on top of a compounding pharmacy, and the shared patient platform that connects them. It is a deliberately broad mandate, and the breadth is the point.

The role is defined by a clear division of decision rights with our Chief Technology Officer.The CTO owns supply— architecture, engineering, data infrastructure, security, reliability, and delivery.The CPO owns demand— the user problems worth solving, the product strategy, the roadmap and its priority order, the discovery work that validates what gets built, and the outcomes the product is accountable for. The two roles are peers at the executive table, reporting to the CEO. Neither stacks under the other.

If you are the kind of product leader who is energized by building a function from the ground up — installing discovery, design, and product analytics as disciplines, growing a high-potential product team, and being personally accountable for whether real patients and providers actually use and value what we ship — this is a rare mandate.

AI is central to this role, not adjacent to it.Our CTO is investing heavily in AHG's AI and data platform — models, ML pipelines, automation, and safety infrastructure. We are looking for a CPO who is the demand-side counterpart to that investment: an AI-native product leader who decides which AI capabilities become real products for patients and clinicians, designs them to earn trust, and runs the product organization itself with AI woven into how the team discovers, prototypes, researches, and measures. You will not be selling AI to a skeptical company — you will be partnering with a technology org that is already all-in, and giving that capability a product and a purpose.

How the Role Works

AHG operates as a multi-entity platform.Each business unit is led by its own CEO who owns that unit's P&L. The CPO leads the product function as a shared, enterprise-wide capability that every business consumes — setting product standards, methods, and talent for the whole company, while owning end-to-end product for the shared patient platform and the new provider EHR directly.

  • Direct ownership:the shared cross-brand patient platform, the provider-network EHR product, the company's product discovery / design / research / analytics disciplines, and the product talent function.
  • Partnership ownership:business-unit roadmaps are set in close partnership with each BU's leadership. You are the executive who brings product rigor, evidence, and prioritization to those conversations — and the executive BU leaders escalate product and UX problems to.
  • Influence over authority:you will succeed here by being the most trusted voice on what's worth building, not by command. The mandate is real, but it is earned through evidence, outcomes, and partnership.
  • Stays with the CTO (not this role):the data warehouse and business intelligence, cloud and platform architecture, security and SOC 2, ERP and infrastructure vendors, engineering delivery, and the AI/ML platform and its safety infrastructure. The CPO sets the demand on these systems — what they must enable and why — while the CTO owns how they are built and run.

Key Responsibilities

Product strategy & portfolio prioritization

  • Own a product strategy for each business and for the portfolio — a distinct artifact from the technology roadmap that states, for each area: the user problem, the hypothesis, the outcome we are trying to move, and what we are deliberately not doing.
  • Prioritize across the portfolio through a product lens, not a bandwidth lens — deciding how finite product and engineering capacity is allocated across competing opportunities based on value, not on who asks loudest.
  • Champion a “connected system over isolated products” approach: a unified patient identity and experience across brands, rather than four disconnected silos.

Product discovery & evidence

  • Install product discovery as a standard: continuous customer and provider interviews, prototype and usability testing, and validated problem definition before significant build begins.
  • Require that major initiatives carry discovery artifacts — interview findings, an explicit hypothesis, and the metric that will tell us we were right or wrong — and make those artifacts drive what gets prioritized.

Design, user research & quality

  • Build the product design, user research, and design-system disciplines AHG needs — accessibility standards, interaction patterns, and a consistent quality bar across every brand and the EHR.
  • Be the executive accountable for whether the product is genuinely usable by the humans who use it — patients, providers, and pharmacists — and the advocate for the user when speed and shipping pressure compete with quality.

Outcomes & product analytics

  • Own outcome metrics, not output metrics: subscription retention and activation in the consumer telehealth brands, provider activation and retention on the EHR, medication adherence in the pharmacy programs, and patient experience (e.g., NPS) across the platform.
  • Stand up product analytics as a discipline distinct from business intelligence — event-level instrumentation, cohort and funnel analysis, and experimentation that lets a product manager find a drop-off and ship a fix against it.

Healthcare product leadership

  • EHR / provider experience:ensure the provider workflow is mapped, observed, and prototyped before production screens are built; reducing clinician cognitive burden is the single biggest determinant of adoption. Own the provider activation funnel end to end.
  • Clinical AI as product:set strategy for AI features that touch patients and clinicians — including an ambient documentation / scribing strategy for the EHR — partnering with the CTO, who owns the AI platform and safety infrastructure. You decide what AI ships to users and hold the line when something isn't ready, even if it is technically deployable.
  • Chronic-care platform layer:design the clinical-engagement layer (adherence, side-effect management, dose support) that turns medication fulfillment into a durable chronic-disease management experience.
  • Platform & interoperability:own the strategic product decision of whether AHG becomes one connected, multi-brand patient experience or stays a set of separate products — and ensure the shared platform and EHR are designed API-first, with a standards-based (HL7 / FHIR) encounter layer open enough to integrate external pharmacy, lab, imaging, and ambient-AI services rather than a closed system.
  • Regulated by design:partner with Compliance and Clinical so that product decisions respect HIPAA, telehealth, FDA, and clinical-safety requirements from the start, not as an afterthought.

An AI-first product organization

  • AI in the product:treat AI as a core design surface, not a bolt-on feature — set the strategy for the AI capabilities that touch patients and providers (triage and coaching assistants, ambient documentation, adherence and follow-up agents, decision support), partnering with the CTO who owns the underlying AI/ML platform and safety infrastructure.
  • Agentic AI with proportionate oversight:match the level of human oversight to the cost of a mistake — autonomous with audit logging for low-stakes, high-volume tasks; human-in-the-loop for medium-stakes; mandatory clinician review and accountability for anything liability-bearing. You decide what AI ships to users and hold the line when something isn't ready, even if it is technically deployable.
  • An AI-native team:run the product function itself with AI built into how the team works — AI-assisted user-research synthesis, rapid prototyping, competitive and market analysis, PRD and spec drafting, and product-analytics querying — so a small product team operates with outsized leverage. We want a leader who raises the bar on what AI-augmented product work looks like and hires people who think the same way.
  • Trustworthy by design:ensure AI features show their reasoning, expose confidence, and always leave a clear human override — in regulated healthcare this is a trust and liability standard, not a preference.

Team & cross-functional leadership

  • Build the product organization — hiring, leveling, and career paths for product managers, designers, and researchers, and developing existing high-potential product talent into senior leaders.
  • Partner deeply with the CTO and engineering to co-own delivery of the core platform, data products, and AI-enabled systems — product owns what and why; engineering owns how.
  • Serve as the bridge between the executive team and the product organization, translating company strategy into a roadmap and reporting on outcomes at the board level.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

  • A documented product strategy exists for each business and the portfolio, distinct from the tech roadmap, and is driving prioritization decisions.
  • Discovery, design, user research, and product analytics exist as functioning disciplines — with the right early hires in place — not as ad-hoc activities.
  • The provider EHR has a mapped clinical workflow, a decided ambient-AI strategy, and a measured provider activation funnel before — or at — launch.
  • Outcome metrics (retention, provider activation, adherence, NPS) are instrumented, visible to leadership, and owned by Product.
  • Business-unit leaders treat the CPO as the trusted partner they negotiate roadmap with and escalate product problems to.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 12+ years in product, with 5+ years in an executive product role (CPO, SVP/VP of Product, or equivalent) at a digital health, healthtech, regulated-SaaS, or enterprise-technology company.
  • A track record of building and scaling multi-product or platform-based ecosystems — not managing a single product line.
  • Direct experience in a regulated environment (healthcare strongly preferred; fintech or similarly regulated industries considered), including HIPAA, telehealth, FDA, or clinical-safety contexts.
  • Range across both of AHG's product worlds: consumer DTC subscription product (acquisition, activation, retention economics) AND provider- or clinical-facing product (clinical workflow, provider adoption). Deep expertise in one is required; credible, demonstrated range into the other is essential — this role cannot be filled by a single-surface specialist.
  • A proven partnership with a CTO/engineering leadership to bring complex products to market, with a clear, healthy demand-vs-supply working model.
  • Experience standing up product discovery, design, user research, and product analytics as disciplines — having built the function, not just inherited it.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI-powered product features — ideally including LLM and agentic-AI use cases — with a clear point of view on oversight, safety, and trust in a high-stakes or regulated setting.

Skills & attributes

  • A strategic thinker who turns vision into evidence-based, prioritized roadmaps — and who says “no” well.
  • Deep product-led-growth and outcomes orientation; fluent in retention, activation, cohort, and funnel analysis.
  • A builder's instinct for design and user research quality, with the judgment to hold a quality bar under shipping pressure.
  • An influence-first operator comfortable leading a shared function across autonomous business units without relying on positional authority.
  • AI-native in how you work and lead — you use AI tools fluently across discovery, prototyping, research, and analysis, and you expect your team to; you are energized, not threatened, by a technology org going all-in on AI.
  • Strong business and commercial acumen — able to tie product investment to revenue, margin, and enterprise value, and to make that case to the board.
  • Excellent communication and executive presence; calm and clarifying in ambiguity and high growth.

Why Join AHG

  • Found the function.You will be AHG's first product executive, with the mandate to define how product is done across the company.
  • Real stakes, real users.Your work directly shapes patient and provider outcomes across pharmacy, telehealth, and a new EHR.
  • A clear seat.A defined demand-vs-supply partnership with a strong CTO, and a direct line to the CEO and board.
  • AI-forward, with a real platform behind it.Partner with a technology organization investing heavily in AI and data infrastructure — and own the product side of turning that capability into things patients and clinicians actually trust and use.
  • Platform-level impact.Decide whether AHG becomes one connected patient experience or stays four silos — one of the most consequential product calls in the company's next five years.

Allia Health Group is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

You'll work directly with high-value and high-risk accounts, understand what's driving their concerns, and create practical plans to resolve the issues and earn their continued business. You'll also help Customer Success Managers become better at identifying and addressing problems before they turn into cancellations. This is a highly visible role where you'll have a direct impact on customer satisfaction, retention, and recurring revenue — with the opportunity to turn what you learn from customers into better processes, playbooks, and company-wide improvements.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $70k - $90k

  • Performance Bonus, On-Target Earnings (OTE): $120k - $150k

  • Comprehensive paid training and onboarding

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own retention efforts for high-risk and high-value customer accounts, using account health, usage, support history, payment activity, and customer feedback to identify and prioritize risk.

  • Proactively reach out to customers showing signs of dissatisfaction or potential cancellation before the relationship is lost.

  • Develop account-specific retention plans that clearly outline the problem, required actions, responsible parties, and follow-up timeline.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high-value cancellation situations.

Para citar o que inúmeros membros da equipe da TNC dizem: “você se juntará por causa da nossa missão e ficará por nossas pessoas”.

Nosso impacto

  • 71 milhões de hectares: impacto positivo almejado até 2030, com foco em conservação e aprimoramento da gestão.

  • 187 mil km de rios: extensão para a qual a TNC Brasil busca promover soluções e políticas públicas de conservação até 2030.

  • 369 milhões de toneladas de CO₂: volume de emissões que a organização pretende capturar ou contribuir para reduzir até 2030.

  • 3,8 milhões de pessoas: público que a TNC Brasil pretende apoiar, com atenção especial a povos tradicionais e comunidades indígenas, ampliando sua participação em espaços decisórios e sua liderança na gestão dos territórios.

Na Amazônia, exemplos recentes ajudam a dimensionar essa atuação: um projeto de Pagamento por Serviços Ambientais na Terra do Meio envolve 14 territórios coletivos, 3 mil pessoas e 10 milhões de hectares sob proteção de uso sustentável.

Propósito do cargo

Liderar a estratégia da TNC na Amazônia Brasileira a partir de uma visão sistêmica do território, conciliando conservação e desenvolvimento socioeconômico. O desafio será conectar diferentes agendas, atores e investimentos para transformar estratégias em resultados concretos e escaláveis, capazes de manter a floresta em pé, promover uma produção responsável e gerar valor para as pessoas e comunidades da Amazônia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e implementar a estratégia e a Teoria da Mudança da TNC para a Amazônia Brasileira, traduzindo a visão institucional em prioridades, iniciativas e resultados mensuráveis.

  • Liderar um portfólio amplo e diverso, conectando agendas de produção agropecuária sustentável, proteção e valorização da floresta em pé, povos indígenas e comunidades tradicionais, clima, mecanismos financeiros e políticas públicas.

  • Assegurar capacidade de implementação e entrega, transformando estratégias em resultados concretos, monitorando avanços e adaptando planos diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Promover uma visão de desenvolvimento socioeconômico da Amazônia, articulando conservação e produção responsável e identificando alavancas econômicas capazes de valorizar a floresta em pé.

  • Identificar oportunidades para ampliar iniciativas bem-sucedidas, superando a lógica de projetos-piloto e promovendo soluções com potencial de transformação sistêmica e atuação em larga escala.

  • Construir e fortalecer relações estratégicas com governos estaduais e federal, setor privado, instituições financeiras, produtores, academia, organizações da sociedade civil, financiadores, povos indígenas, quilombolas, extrativistas e outras comunidades tradicionais.

  • Influenciar políticas públicas, estruturas de governança e processos de tomada de decisão relevantes para o desenvolvimento sustentável da Amazônia.

  • Liderar e apoiar a captação de recursos no Brasil e internacionalmente, mantendo um pipeline consistente de oportunidades e relacionamento estratégico com financiadores.

  • Supervisionar a gestão financeira e orçamentária de um portfólio de grande porte, assegurando uso eficiente dos recursos, sustentabilidade financeira e conformidade institucional.

  • Liderar gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, fortalecendo estruturas, responsabilidades, autonomia, accountability e capacidades técnicas e gerenciais.

  • Estimular integração e sinergia entre diferentes frentes de atuação, evitando silos e promovendo circulação de contexto e informação para qualificar a tomada de decisão.

  • Manter e fortalecer a agenda de diversidade, equidade e inclusão dentro da unidade, incorporando-a à liderança e à gestão da equipe.

  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC em fóruns, negociações e espaços estratégicos nacionais e internacionais.

Requisitos e competências para trabalhar conosco

Educação

  • Formação superior completa em áreas relacionadas à gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, economia ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação em áreas correlatas será considerada desejável.

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência profissional em posições relacionadas a desenvolvimento socioeconômico, gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, conservação ou áreas correlatas, com trajetória relevante em contextos complexos e de grande escala.

  • Experiência robusta na definição e implementação de estratégias, com responsabilidade por portfólios complexos, priorização de iniciativas, gestão de riscos e entrega de resultados mensuráveis.

  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento de talentos, estruturação de equipes e gestão de desempenho.

  • Trajetória de articulação multissetorial, estabelecendo relações e conduzindo negociações complexas com governos, setor privado, organizações da sociedade civil, comunidades, financiadores e outros atores estratégicos.

  • Experiência em relações governamentais e políticas públicas, incluindo capacidade de influenciar agendas, processos decisórios e condições institucionais necessárias para alcançar resultados em escala.

  • Experiência na gestão financeira e orçamentária de programas de grande porte, combinando visão estratégica com capacidade de acompanhamento da execução.

  • Experiência em captação de recursos e relacionamento com financiadores, contribuindo para a construção e manutenção de um pipeline de financiamento no Brasil e/ou internacionalmente.

  • Será especialmente valorizada uma trajetória que demonstre conhecimento e compreensão do contexto amazônico, incluindo suas dinâmicas socioeconômicas, produtivas, ambientais, políticas e territoriais.

  • Será um diferencial experiência com mecanismos financeiros, finanças estruturadas, setor privado ou desenvolvimento econômico, especialmente quando aplicada a desafios socioambientais e/ou territoriais.

    Conhecimento e habilidades

  • Visão sistêmica da Amazônia: capacidade de compreender o território para além de uma única agenda temática, conectando desenvolvimento socioeconômico, conservação, produção agropecuária, floresta, clima, povos e comunidades tradicionais, políticas públicas e investimentos.

  • Pensamento estratégico e de escala: capacidade de identificar as principais alavancas de transformação de um sistema e desenvolver soluções que possam avançar de iniciativas pontuais para resultados de maior escala.

  • Gestão e implementação: capacidade de transformar estratégia em execução, estabelecer prioridades, acompanhar resultados e replanejar recursos e ações diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Articulação e negociação: habilidade para navegar entre interesses distintos, construir agendas comuns e mobilizar atores públicos, privados e sociais em torno de objetivos compartilhados.

  • Visão econômico-financeira: capacidade de compreender o papel de investimentos, mecanismos financeiros, setor privado e modelos econômicos na construção de soluções sustentáveis para a Amazônia.

  • Captação e mobilização de recursos: habilidade para desenvolver relações com financiadores, identificar oportunidades e contribuir estrategicamente para a sustentabilidade financeira do portfólio.

  • Inglês avançado, oral e escrito, considerando as interações, apresentações e eventos internacionais inerentes à posição. Inglês fluente é desejável e conhecimentos de espanhol serão considerados um diferencial.

Competências

  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico: conecta diferentes variáveis e agendas, compreende interdependências e mantém uma visão ampla do território sem perder a capacidade de priorização.

  • Orientação à implementação e resultados: transforma estratégia em ação, acompanha a execução e mantém foco consistente nas entregas e no impacto esperado.

  • Liderança adaptativa: lidera com segurança em contextos de incerteza e complexidade, sendo capaz de rever planos, redirecionar prioridades e mobilizar o time diante de mudanças.

  • Influência e construção de consensos: estabelece relações de confiança e consegue aproximar atores com interesses e perspectivas distintas.

  • Liderança de pessoas: desenvolve equipes fortes e tecnicamente qualificadas, compartilha contexto, promove autonomia e evita a formação de silos na tomada de decisão.

  • Colaboração e integração: consegue navegar por um portfólio diverso sem precisar ser especialista em todas as temáticas, conectando conhecimentos, pessoas e iniciativas para gerar sinergias.

  • Proatividade e senso de protagonismo: antecipa necessidades, identifica oportunidades e mobiliza recursos e pessoas para fazer a estratégia avançar.

  • Compromisso com diversidade, equidade e inclusão: incorpora essa agenda à forma de liderar, desenvolver equipes e construir uma cultura organizacional inclusiva.

Perfil de nossa equipe

A The Nature Conservancy é enraizada em nossa missão e guiada por nossos valores. Temos o compromisso de cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos os colegas ao redor do mundo sintam um senso de pertencimento e tenham suas contribuições únicas valorizadas. Nosso objetivo é construir uma força de trabalho diversa que reflita as comunidades em que atuamos, reconhecendo que a diversidade de experiências e habilidades é fundamental para a inovação.

“Você vai se juntar a nós pela nossa missão — e vai ficar pelas nossas pessoas.”

Principais interesses para trabalhar conosco

O candidato ideal será motivado pela oportunidade de causar um impacto direto nos esforços globais de conservação.

Deve ter um forte interesse em sustentabilidade ambiental, proteção da biodiversidade e conservação de ecossistemas críticos no Brasil.

Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • A oportunidade de liderar uma estratégia de alta relevância para um dos biomas mais importantes para a biodiversidade e estabilidade climática global.

  • Atuação sobre desafios complexos que conectam desenvolvimento econômico, produção sustentável, conservação, clima, comunidades e políticas públicas.

  • Liderança de um portfólio diversificado e de uma equipe multidisciplinar em uma organização de alcance global.

  • Possibilidade de articular governos, setor privado, investidores, financiadores, comunidades e sociedade civil em torno de mudanças sistêmicas.

  • Espaço para construir soluções que ultrapassem projetos-piloto e alcancem escala e transformação de sistemas.

Detalhes relevantes antes de se candidatar a esta vaga

A posição exige residência fixa em uma capital da Amazônia Brasileira, em modelo home office. Também requer disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais e atuação eventual em locais remotos e condições climáticas ou de terreno desafiadoras.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (AI)
jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to be a big part of something big? At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience.
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We're a group of go-getters who decided they didn't want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

And one of the best parts? We give you the freedom to work from whatever working location works best for you and your lifestyle - yes, this means you can be 100% remote if you want to be!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You'll Do

The Senior Product Manager (AI) is responsible for defining, delivering, and iterating AI-powered products and capabilities throughout the product life cycle — connecting data, machine learning, and large language models to real customer/consumer problems and measurable business outcomes.

  • Own the vision, strategy, and market fit for AI-powered products and experiences within your domain (e.g., recommendations, pricing, search, workflow automation, conversational tools).

  • Build deep consumer and dealer understanding through interviews, discovery sessions, and usage analytics to identify where AI can add real value (and where it should not be used).

  • Serve as internal and external subject matter expert on your AI products, including their capabilities, limitations, and responsible-use guidelines, measurement and monitoring.

  • Own the end-to-end product plan for AI capabilities, from discovery and problem framing through launch, adoption, and continuous optimization.

  • Drive innovative, AI-enabled solutions that align to strategic business goals and are grounded in realistic data, model, and UX constraints.

  • Gather business and data requirements from a variety of sources (consumers, dealers, account owners, sales, support, data science) and translate them into clear product outcomes and increments.

  • Document and elaborate requirements, partnering with business and technology leadership to prioritize AI opportunities within the overall product roadmap.

  • Maintain and prioritize a large product backlog that includes discovery, experimentation, and delivery work for AI features, as well as the data and tech debt required to keep them healthy.

  • Serve as subject matter expert in relevant product domains, assisting with customer UAT, defect triage, and mitigation efforts — with particular attention to AI-specific issues such as output quality, bias, hallucination, and safety.

  • Partner with stakeholders to define minimum viable products for AI features, balancing value, feasibility, risk, and responsible-use considerations.

  • Inspect, accept, or reject completed development work against defined acceptance criteria, UX standards, and key performance metrics for AI behaviors.

  • Communicate work in progress, results from experiments, and upcoming priorities to key internal and external stakeholders in a clear, non-hype way.

  • Collaborate across Data, Sales, Design, other Product teams, QA, and Engineering to produce prototypes and proof-of-concept experiences that validate AI opportunities quickly.

  • Collaborate with software development and data science to build robust, scalable AI solutions for existing and potential customers.

  • Develop a nuanced understanding of the target markets and user bases (including their workflows and risk tolerance) to guide decisions on AI product backlog and prioritization.

  • Contribute to business cases that justify AI investments, clearly articulating expected value, costs (including model and infrastructure costs), and key risks.

  • Conduct customer, market, and competitive analysis to identify industry trends, market gaps, and unmet customer needs, with a specific lens on how AI is changing user expectations.

  • Act as project manager lead in strategic AI initiatives for discovery and delivery, ensuring tight coordination across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree in product management, business administration, engineering or a related field.

  • 4-6 years of relevant product management, product ownership, business analytics or beta analytics experience in a software product development environment.

  • 5+ years of relevant product management, product ownership, or closely related experience in a software product development environment, including 2+ years working on AI/ML-powered features or data products.

  • Experience in a role with strong requirements elicitation and stakeholder management across technical and non-technical groups.

  • Experience with customer support and bug tracking.

  • Experience and proficiency with modern product and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, yED, G Suite); familiarity with analytics or experimentation tools is a plus (Optimizely, Fullstory, Adobe, etc.).

  • Previous experience in marketplaces, advertising, e-commerce, SaaS, or other data-rich domains is a plus.

Bonus Points

Not specified in this posting.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

About the Client

Our client is one of the nation's largest performance marketing organizations specializing in real estate lead generation. With more than $20 million in annual paid media spend, the company has built its success through data-driven decision making, relentless testing, and scalable customer acquisition strategies. Every marketing dollar is invested into growing their own business, making performance, efficiency, and ROI the driving force behind every campaign. As they continue to expand, they are seeking a highly experienced Director of Paid Media to lead and scale their acquisition engine while building world-class paid media and creative operations. This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located within the United States.Job Summary

The Director of Paid Media is a senior leadership role for a highly hands-on marketing operator who enjoys being deeply involved in both strategy and execution. This individual will oversee more than $20 million in annual paid media spend across Meta, Connected TV (CTV), Paid Search, Native, Display, and emerging acquisition channels while leading the company's creative performance strategy.

This role goes well beyond media buying. The Director will oversee the creative team responsible for ad content, messaging, editing, production, testing, and campaign execution, ensuring every creative asset is built with performance and measurable ROI in mind while maintaining quality and increasing spend. They will develop scalable systems for experimentation, optimization, reporting, and forecasting while continuously identifying opportunities to improve lead quality, reduce acquisition costs, and increase return on ad spend.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience within high-volume lead generation organizations—particularly companies that invest significant marketing dollars into generating their own customers rather than managing campaigns for outside clients or agencies. They are equally comfortable analyzing campaign performance, directing creative strategy, building operational processes, and personally working inside advertising platforms to drive results.

What We Offer

  • $160k - $175k Base Salary

  • Performance-based bonus opportunities = On-Target-Earnings (OTE) of $200k+

  • Fully remote position (U.S.-based)

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid Time Off and company holidays

  • 401(k) with company match (if applicable)

  • Executive-level ownership of a $20M+ annual paid media budget

  • Opportunity to build and lead a best-in-class performance marketing organization

  • Collaborative, fast-paced, data-driven culture

  • Significant career growth with direct executive visibility

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, execution, optimization, and scaling of a $20M+ annual paid media budget across Meta, CTV, Paid Search, Native, Display, and emerging channels.

  • Remain highly hands-on within advertising platforms, personally monitoring campaign performance and driving optimization efforts.

  • Lead and mentor the creative team responsible for ad copy, video production, graphic design, editing, messaging, and campaign execution.

  • Ensure all creative initiatives are driven by measurable performance, testing frameworks, and return on investment.

  • Build structured experimentation programs that continuously improve creative performance, lead quality, and customer acquisition costs.

  • Develop scalable marketing systems for campaign launches, QA, reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and operational excellence.

  • Partner cross-functionally with executive leadership to align paid media strategy with overall business objectives.

  • Develop executive dashboards and reporting that clearly communicate campaign performance, business impact, and future growth opportunities.

  • Identify new acquisition channels, audience opportunities, and scaling strategies while maintaining profitability and efficiency.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous testing, and data-driven decision making across the marketing organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience with increasing leadership responsibility.

  • Proven success managing $20M+ annual paid media budgets with strong ROAS and customer acquisition performance.

  • Extensive expertise managing Meta Ads and Connected TV (CTV) campaigns at scale.

  • Strong experience with Paid Search, Native Advertising, Display, and other digital acquisition channels.

  • Experience leading creative teams responsible for content strategy, ad production, editing, testing, optimization, and performance measurement.

  • Proven background within lead generation businesses that invest heavily in acquiring their own customers—not agency-side marketing.

  • Deep understanding of attribution, conversion tracking, analytics, forecasting, and performance reporting.

  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable marketing systems, testing frameworks, and operational processes.

  • Exceptional leadership, analytical, communication, and project management skills with a passion for continuous optimization and measurable business growth.

jobs.description:
Collinson is the global, privately-owned company dedicated to helping the world to travel with ease and confidence. The group offers a unique blend of industry and sector specialists who together provide market-leading airport experiences, loyalty and customer engagement, and insurance solutions for over 400 million consumers.

Collinson is the operator of Priority Pass, the world’s original and leading airport experiences programme. Travellers can access a network of 1,500+ lounges and travel experiences, including dining, retail, sleep and spa, in over 650 airports in 148 countries, helping to elevate the journey into something special. We work with the world’s leading payment networks, over 1,400 banks, 90 airlines and 20 hotel groups worldwide.

We have been bringing innovation to the market since inception – from launching the first independent global VIP lounge access Programme, Priority Pass to being the first to sell direct travel insurance in the UK through Columbus Direct and creating the first loyalty agency of its kind in the travel sector with ICLP. Today we still invest heavily in innovation to ensure that we continue to deliver superior customer experiences.

Key clients include Mastercard, American Express, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, LATAM, Flying Blue, Accor, EasyJet, HSBC, Chase, HDFC.

Our mission is focused on doing good beyond profit, which for us means we seek out opportunities for our people to share in our success and that we give back to the communities and people within which we work.

Never short of ambition, the success of our business is delivered through the diverse and talented team of over 2,200 global colleagues.

We're growing our team in Poland and want to be upfront about how this role is structured. As we don't yet have a legal entity in Poland, we work with an Employer of Record (EOR) or umbrella company to onboard talent in the region. This means the role is offered on a fixed term basis via an international contractor agreement — and is fully remote.

Purpose of the job:

The Senior IOS Developer at Collinson's Travel Experience Division will be at the forefront of bringing

our visionary roadmap to life, focusing on delivering globally appealing, customer centric solutions.

Acknowledging the importance of regional nuances, the chosen candidate will guarantee that our

digital offerings strike a chord at both the universal and localized levels. This role is pivotal in

architecting and developing iOS applications that offer a smooth, user-friendly travel experience for

our global clientele.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and build advanced applications for the iOS platform.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.

  • Maintain and improve existing codebase, focusing on continuous integration and deployment strategies.

  • Work on bug fixing and improving application performance.

  • Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the application.

  • Integrate with third-party libraries and APIs, ensuring seamless functionality.

  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximize development efficiency.

  • Coordinate with the design team to ensure UI/UX best practices are followed.

  • Address any security vulnerabilities and work to ensure a secure app environment.

  • Stay updated with the latest mobile trends, architectures, and emerging technologies.

Knowledge, skills and experience required

  • 4-8 years of strong design/development experience overall, with 4+ years of mobile development experience
