jobs.description:
About Us

Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions. Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood—a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. We are a wacky bunch who are intent on spreading joy! (We just mailed out stickers to over 200 local health health professionals because we felt they could use more joy!)

As Salesforce, Microsoft, Snowflake, and AWS partners, we specialize in technology implementation with a strong people focus. We combine this with strategic planning, data analysis, coaching, and facilitation to effectively support local public health department staff.

Our core values are:

  • People First
  • Focus on Capacity Building
  • Belief in Continuous Experimentation
  • By Public Heath; For Public Health
  • We Do What Is Right. Always.

We're seeking passionate, joyful individuals who align with our ethos of being different and making a difference.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL/ TRIBAL/ STATE/ FEDERAL).

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us – it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds – they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about the possibility of expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Notice

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be considered disqualified.

Senior Salesforce Developer

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH GOVERNMENTAL PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL / TRIBAL / STATE / FEDERAL). IF YOU HAVE THAT EXPERIENCE IN ADDITION TO SALESFORCE SKILLS, PLEASE ENSURE IT IS CLEAR ON YOUR RESUME.

What do we mean by governmental public health? We're looking for people who have worked directly for a public health agency: a local health department, tribal health organization, state health department, or federal public health agency like CDC or HRSA. We require this because there's no substitute for the lived experience of navigating government systems, understanding the constraints public health staff face, and developing genuine empathy for the people doing this work. That empathy shapes how we build solutions.

Compensation Note: If a salary range is listed for this position, please note that we will be offering at the starting point of the band. We cover 100% of your health insurance!

Role Overview

We're seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer who combines strong technical expertise with a deep understanding of public health operations. You'll lead development efforts on complex implementations, mentor junior developers, and help shape the technical direction of solutions that serve health departments nationwide.

This role is about building technology that fits how public health actually operates. Your background in public health means you can anticipate needs before they're articulated, push back on designs that won't work in practice, and advocate for the end users who will rely on what you build. You won't just execute on requirements. You'll help define what the right solution looks like.

You'll be part of a collaborative team working on our PH360 platform and client implementations. You'll work alongside architects to make technical decisions, guide junior developers in their growth, and bring your public health perspective to every design conversation. We're looking for someone who wants to build systems that genuinely make public health work better.

If you've ever been frustrated by technology that didn't fit the reality of public health work, this is your chance to build it right.

How You'll Work

You'll be part of an Agile Release Train (ART) that follows SAFe principles. This means:

  • Program Increment (PI) Planning: You'll participate in quarterly planning sessions, helping shape the technical roadmap and contributing your public health perspective
  • Sprint Collaboration: You'll work in two-week sprints with daily standups, regular backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives
  • Technical Leadership: You'll guide technical decisions within your team and help junior developers grow their skills
  • Cross-functional Partnership: You'll work closely with solutions analysts, architects, and QA to ensure what we build truly serves our clients

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flow
  • Lead technical discussions and contribute to solution design alongside architects
  • Mentor junior developers through pair programming, code reviews, and guidance
  • Bring your public health perspective to technical decisions and design conversations
  • Write clean, well-documented, testable code that sets the standard for the team
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges
  • Collaborate with QA to ensure high-quality deliverables
  • Help translate public health requirements into scalable technical implementations
  • Contribute to code reviews with constructive, supportive feedback

Experience Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • 1-3 years working for a governmental public health agency (local, state, federal, or tribal)
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required (Platform Developer II preferred)
  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe environments
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Track record of mentoring or guiding less experienced developers

Technical Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation tools
  • Solid understanding of Salesforce data modeling and security model
  • Familiarity with integration patterns and REST/SOAP APIs
  • Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks and test-driven development

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification
  • Experience with Service Cloud or Health Cloud
  • Familiarity with HIPAA compliance requirements
  • Experience with SAFe Agile methodology
  • Background in public health data systems, case management, or epidemiology workflows

Notice

Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Willingness to adhere to our no-drug workplace policy. You must agree to undergo eVerify for employment status at hiring.

No 3rd Party Recruiters.

We value initiative. If you're genuinely interested in this role, show us. (However, please do not use the "Schedule a Meeting" feature on our website. You will be disqualified.) We notice candidates who take the extra step to express real interest. Demonstrate the value that you will add to F&T Labs.

At Flourish and Thrive Labs, we believe in the unique value each candidate brings. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and experiences, even if you don't meet all listed qualifications

Position Summary

Benefits are one of the most consequential things an employer offers and one of the hardest to get right. WEX Professional Services ensures our customers realize the full value of the WEX solution: launching well, adopting fully, and continuing to get more out of the platform as their programs and populations change.

This role owns the commercial engine behind that ambition: pipeline, deal construction, pricing discipline, forecast integrity, and the partnership with Sales, Account Management, and Delivery that puts the right services in front of the right customers at the right moment in their journey.

This is a quota-carrying, player-coach role in a highly matrixed environment. You will be a strategic problem solver with outstanding strategic, enterprise, commercial, and cross-functional skills, bringing high energy and real command of commercial management. You will personally co-lead the largest and most complex pursuits, build the commercial rigor and cadence the business runs on, and position Professional Services as the partner that helps employers, health plans, and administrators design, implement, and optimize their benefits programs, including the commercial strategy for how those services reach customers across segments and channels. You will partner with client executives on a regular basis and maintain positive relationships with internal peers across Delivery, Sales, Account Management, Product, Technology, Finance, and Operations to ensure customer needs are met seamlessly from the initial pitch through successful implementation and beyond.

Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial Results & Customer Outcomes: Exceed Professional Services growth and bookings targets while delivering high customer satisfaction on the engagements you and your team sells. Own the plan to close any gap between committed pipeline and target, including the specific pursuits, timing, and actions that close it.

  • Forecast & Pipeline Discipline: Create and conduct a rigorous forecast and pipeline cadence, maintain data hygiene, early risk calls, and the commentary leadership relies on to run the business. Surface forecast changes early with a recommendation attached. Report clearly on sales activity and forecasts to senior management. Mentor team on strategies to drive closings.

  • Deal Construction & Commercial Viability: Lead strategy, pricing, and structuring of services engagements in partnership with Delivery, Operations, Deal Desk, and RevOps. Bring command of statement of work mechanics, engagement risk assessment, and margin preservation. Ensure engagements are priced to their economics and structured with clear scope, assumptions, and commercial terms.

  • Delivery Partnership: Partner as a trusted peer with Delivery leadership so that engagements are realistically scoped, properly staffed, and commercially viable before they are signed. Collaborate to bridge the gap between pre-sales vision and successful implementation, safeguarding both project margins and customer success.

  • Sales & Account Management Partnership: Serve as the commercial front door to ProServ for Sales and Growth leaders. Build a working cadence with those leaders and teams so that services are positioned early in pursuits.

  • Segmentation & Channel Strategy: Craft the commercial strategy for how services are positioned, priced, and sold across customer segments and routes to market, including direct employer relationships and customers who come to WEX through partners. Define which services matter most in each segment, where they attach in the customer journey, and how the offer and pricing should differ across them.

  • Executive Customer Engagement / Consulting: Personally lead value and economics conversations with client executives at the largest strategic accounts, and serve as executive sponsor on key engagements. Stay active in the field, including customer-site travel where the relationship warrants it.

  • Team Leadership & Development: Mentor and develop the services sales team, including recruiting, hiring, training, pipeline management, opportunity management, deal reviews, performance management, and career planning. Lead the team through WEX's technology and AI journey by demonstrating adoption of the tools yourself and promoting innovation in how the team sells.

  • Enterprise Contribution: Operate as an enterprise leader beyond the services number. Anticipate commercial risk and opportunity early, connect services performance to the broader Health & Benefits vision and strategy, and contribute as a peer to cross-functional leaders on the decisions that shape the customer experience.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in professional services sales, consulting, or solution sales, including direct accountability for a services number and a track record of consistent quota over-achievement.

  • 3+ years of sales management and consultative selling experience, with a track record of building and developing commercial teams.

  • Experience selling professional services inside a technology, software, or platform business, with demonstrated command of the services attach motion: positioning services early in a license or subscription cycle, navigating the tension between platform revenue and services revenue, understanding how services investment supports platform growth and retention, and earning the trust of quota-carrying sellers who do not report to you.

  • Strong commercial acumen paired with genuine understanding of services delivery dynamics: SOW mechanics, project / engagement risk, staffing realities, and margin preservation.

  • Proven ability to develop and maintain C-level relationships where you are recognized as a trusted advisor.

  • Thrive operating in ambiguity and building the structure in a fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated learning velocity. This is a regulated market where credibility with customers depends on understanding their business. Candidates without direct benefits experience should be able to point to a market they learned from scratch, what they did to become credible, and how they knew when they were.

  • Highly collaborative and excels in a highly complex, matrix environment working across both sales and delivery ecosystems.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to construct a clear commercial narrative for both customers and senior internal audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in benefits administration, consumer-directed healthcare, payments, or healthcare technology.

  • Working command of how employers, health plans, brokers, and third-party administrators buy, the regulatory environment shaping benefits programs, and how the annual enrollment cycle affects implementation timing and scope.

  • Experience building or scaling an advisory or consulting offer within a technology or platform business.

  • Exposure to services P&L construction, utilization, and margin management.

jobs.description:
This role is part of our DAKboard team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.

DAKboard is a fast-growing smart display platform that transforms any screen into a personalized dashboard. From syncing calendars, to showcasing family photos, to displaying weather, to-dos, news, and traffic, DAKboard is where the digital world comes together in one simple, elegant view. Tens of thousands of households, offices, and small businesses already use DAKboard every day for everything from family command centers to lobby welcome boards and conference room schedules. With its intuitive drag-and-drop customization and ever-expanding set of integrations, DAKboard has built a passionate user community, and is just getting started.

Profile Overview

DAKboard is looking for a senior marketer to own its marketing end to end: planning it, building it, running it, and measuring it. It's a hands-on, senior role for someone who wants to build a marketing engine from the ground up and run it themselves, backed by part-time contractors, saas.group's central marketing team, and a growing set of AI agents. You'll partner closely with DAKboard's CEO, with real ownership over strategy and execution across a wide range of channels, including email, landing pages and CRO, performance marketing, social, retargeting, partnerships, and SEO content, for a product used by tens of thousands of households across the US.

This role currently has no direct reports. Instead of a team of employees, you work through part-time contractors, saas.group's central marketing specialists, and AI agents, and you do a good part of the hands-on work yourself.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • Get a clear read on DAKboard's current marketing channels and choose where you can make the biggest impact first. There's plenty of room to build things out and automate as you go
  • Take full ownership of at least one channel end to end, building it out properly and automating what can be automated before moving on to the next
  • Start managing DAKboard's part-time contractors (landing pages/content/design, social/email/distribution, paid ads) and put AI agents to work on research, content, and analysis in your day-to-day

Your responsibilities

  • Own DAKboard's marketing strategy end to end: plan it, build it, run it, and measure it, channel by channel
  • Build out and automate DAKboard's channels: email, landing pages and conversion rate optimization, performance marketing (Google Ads, Amazon Ads), social, retargeting, partnerships/affiliates, and SEO content
  • Manage and quality-check the work of part-time contractors across these channels
  • Set up, manage, and scale a growing set of AI agents and tools to cover research, content, analysis, and automation
  • Partner closely with DAKboard's CEO on priorities, budget, and testing new channels
  • Write and speak in a way that genuinely resonates with DAKboard's core audience: busy US families and parents

What You bring to the table

  • You think in systems, not just channels, and can look at DAKboard's marketing as a whole to figure out what to focus on next
  • Delegation comes naturally to you. You can scope a project clearly, hand it off to a contractor, an agency, or an AI agent, and judge the quality of what comes back
  • You're organized and self-driven, the kind of person who follows through without anyone chasing you, and you're just as comfortable writing the marketing content and setting up a system yourself as planning the strategy behind it
  • You already use AI tools and agents every day in your own marketing work, for research, content, and analysis, and you can show us real examples. Our interview process includes a short practical exercise with AI tools.
  • You've marketed a B2C SaaS or subscription product before, ideally with ownership across more than one channel. Hardware or e-commerce experience helps, but it's not required
  • You're a fast learner. saas.group's central marketing team already has hands-on experience across every channel and with AI automation systems, so you don't need to have mastered them all yourself. You just need to pick up new approaches quickly and put them to work
  • Your English is native-level American, with a natural feel for how US consumers talk and think, so what you write actually sounds like DAKboard's audience

Nice to have: experience with email marketing at scale, CRO/landing page optimization, performance marketing (Google Ads, retargeting), partner/reseller/affiliate program management, or smart-home, consumer electronics, or family-tech products.

What's in it for You

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

DAKboard is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

Role Summary

Revamp is seeking a Senior Project Manager for High Voltage Engineering to lead the delivery of substation and interconnection engineering for utility-scale renewable energy projects. You will help move clean energy from development to construction by turning complex high voltage scopes into reliable execution plans and accountable delivery.

You will oversee a portfolio or suite of projects with substantial independence, approving scopes, budgets, schedules, and work plans while seeking guidance only when necessary. You will serve as a trusted partner to clients, utilities, subcontractors, and internal discipline leads, and you will mentor project staff so teams can deliver high-quality work with transparency and sound judgment. You will coordinate closely with electrical, structural, civil, and power systems teams and help build an inclusive project culture where everyone's contribution is recognized.

Duties & Responsibilities

Core Technical & Functional Responsibilities

  • Independently apply extensive and diversified knowledge of engineering consulting and project management practices to high voltage substation and interconnection projects.
  • Oversee multiple complex projects or a portfolio of related projects from proposal development through closeout.
  • Interpret contract, proposal, and scope language and translate delivery requirements into clear direction for project teams and clients.
  • Develop and finalize proposals, scopes, budgets, schedules, work plans, and resource plans for high voltage assignments.
  • Manage internal discipline and subconsultant deliverables, including construction drawings, equipment specifications, RFIs, submittals, change requests, and project correspondence.
  • Prepare, track, and submit monthly project invoicing and maintain accurate project records.
  • Identify complex project risks, scope changes, and schedule impacts, then drive timely decisions and documented resolutions.

  • Coordinate staffing and workload across multiple project teams to maintain delivery capacity and meet client commitments.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

  • Review project deliverables for conformity with client expectations, contractual obligations, utility standards, and applicable jurisdictional requirements.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Establish shared ownership of deliverables and promote inclusive, respectful collaboration across disciplines and project locations.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties including meeting deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or a similar field, or similar applicable work experience.
  • Eight or more years of project management experience in engineering consulting, renewable energy, or a comparable industry.

  • Demonstrated ownership of project scope, schedule, budget, invoicing, and client deliverables across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Ability to read contract and proposal terms and explain their delivery implications to internal teams, clients, utilities, and subcontractors.
  • Ability to independently identify, evaluate, and resolve complex project and delivery issues, seeking guidance only when necessary.
  • Advanced verbal, written, and presentation skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel up to 15% of the time, including overnight trips, to support project sites, client meetings, and team events.

PreferredQualifications

  • Prior high voltage engineering experience before moving into project management, including electrical, structural, protection and controls, physical substation, or transmission work.
  • Experience at a high voltage design-build or high voltage engineering firm.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and subconsultants across a portfolio of projects.
  • PMP certification or similar project management credential.
  • Familiarity with the utility-scale renewable energy project development and interconnection lifecycle.

Benefits for Full-Time Positions

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Position Overview:


The Sinhala Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Sinhalaand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**


Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.

  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Job Title: Financial Analyst / Data Analyst

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (with flexibility for reporting deadlines, month-end cycles, and strategic projects)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Financial Analyst / Data Analyst to build financial models, analyze operational and financial performance, and deliver data-driven insights that support strategic decision-making.

This role combines financial analysis with modern data analytics, requiring strong quantitative skills, business acumen, and proficiency with reporting and BI tools. The Financial Analyst / Data Analyst serves as the bridge between raw data and executive strategy — ensuring reporting is accurate, actionable, and aligned with business goals.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of transforming complex datasets into clear recommendations for leadership and cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Financial Modeling & Strategic Analysis

  • Build and maintain 3-statement financial models including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow projections
    • Create scenario, sensitivity, break-even, ROI, IRR, and valuation analyses to evaluate risks and opportunities
    • Support forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning initiatives
    • Analyze financial performance and identify trends impacting profitability, growth, and operational efficiency

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Query SQL databases and work with large structured datasets
    • Clean, transform, and validate data using Excel, Python, R, or related tools
    • Conduct variance analysis comparing actual performance against budgets and forecasts
    • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports for finance, operations, and leadership teams

Dashboard Development & Business Intelligence

  • Build and maintain KPI dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI tools
    • Ensure reporting consistency, data integrity, and standardized metric definitions across departments
    • Create executive-ready visualizations and reporting packages for leadership and board presentations
    • Improve visibility into operational and financial performance through automated reporting systems

Forecasting, Planning & Business Support

  • Partner with FP&A, finance, sales, and operations teams to refine forecasts and budgets
    • Incorporate real-time business trends into rolling forecasts and scenario planning
    • Support strategic initiatives through financial and operational analysis
    • Translate business needs into measurable KPIs and analytical frameworks

Data Governance & Accuracy

  • Validate and reconcile data sources to ensure accuracy and reliability
    • Document methodologies, assumptions, and reporting processes for transparency and repeatability
    • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, automation, and data quality
    • Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation and analysis workflows

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership and stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, and strategy teams
    • Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
    • Support decision-making with concise, actionable insights backed by data and financial analysis

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strong analytical thinker capable of turning complex data into simple, actionable insights
    • Highly detail-oriented with strong standards for accuracy and consistency
    • Excellent communicator comfortable presenting to executives and stakeholders
    • Curious and proactive in identifying trends, opportunities, and operational risks
    • Strong balance of technical analysis and business understanding

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, business intelligence, or data analytics
    • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills including pivot tables, INDEX/MATCH, lookup formulas, and modeling
    • Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing datasets
    • Experience preparing variance analyses, forecasting models, and management reports
    • Ability to work with large datasets and synthesize findings clearly

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and data transformation
    • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
    • Industry experience in SaaS, finance, healthcare, or professional services
    • Experience extracting data from ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle
    • Knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and operational KPI frameworks
    • Exposure to automation or advanced reporting workflows

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Financial Analyst / Data Analyst’s day revolves around transforming financial and operational data into meaningful business insights. You will:

  • Pull, clean, and validate data from SQL databases, ERP systems, or reporting platforms
    • Update financial models and run scenario analyses based on the latest business performance
    • Prepare variance analyses explaining deviations from forecast or budget
    • Build and maintain dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into KPIs
    • Collaborate with stakeholders to interpret data and support strategic decisions
    • Document assumptions, methodologies, and reporting logic to ensure consistency and transparency

In essence: you ensure leadership always has accurate, timely, and actionable insights to guide business decisions and long-term strategy.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Forecast and model accuracy within agreed variance thresholds
    • Timely delivery of monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting
    • Reliability and usability of dashboards and reporting tools
    • Improved data quality and reporting consistency
    • Actionable insights that support strategic and operational decisions
    • Positive stakeholder feedback on reporting clarity and analytical support

  • Practical Assessment (e.g., financial model, dashboard creation, or analytical case study)

As a critical member of the CES implementation team, the CES Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating program operations related to the CES process and workflow. This includes effectively matching housing referrals to program openings and unit vacancies; actively monitoring CES workflows to ensure resource alignment; supporting system navigation activities to reduce move-in timelines; and addressing barriers at both the system- and program-levels to ensure continuous CES outflow. The position serves as a key liaison between housing providers, outreach teams, shelters, access sites, and other community partners to facilitate effective housing matching, referral management, and successful housing placements.

Coordinated Entry Implementation

  • Implement CoC CES policies, procedures, and requirements, including administration of CES assessment tools, prioritization policies, referral processes and workflows (including relevant HMIS technologies), project-level eligibility, and matching protocols.

On The Stage is looking for a creative, highly organized Marketing Content Coordinator to help produce compelling, useful content for prospects, customers, and internal teams.

This is a hands-on role for an early-career marketer who enjoys turning ideas, subject-matter expertise, and campaign briefs into polished content. You will support content production across email, blogs, ebooks, infographics, how-to guides, quick-start guides, website assets, presentations, product release materials, and other marketing deliverables.

You will work across the Marketing team, supporting both new-business and customer-marketing initiatives. You will also partner with subject-matter experts across Product, Sales, Customer Success departments to translate complex information into clear, engaging content.

The ideal candidate is a strong writer and editor with excellent project-management instincts, an eye for visual communication, and the curiosity to learn our products, customers, and industry.

What You'll Do

Content Development & Production

  • Draft, edit, and produce marketing content across a variety of formats, including emails, blog posts, ebooks, infographics, how-to guides, quick-start guides, checklists, one-pagers, customer stories, and campaign assets.
  • Turn briefs, interviews, meeting notes, transcripts, and product documentation into clear, audience-focused content.
  • Adapt core ideas into multiple formats and channels to extend the value of each content investment.

  • Proofread and quality-check content for clarity, accuracy, grammar, brand alignment, links, formatting, and accessibility.
  • Help maintain the content calendar and keep drafts, reviews, approvals, design, and publishing on schedule.

Website & Digital Content

  • Create and update marketing copy and supporting assets for the OTS website.
  • Format pages for readability, consistency, accessibility, and conversion.
  • Apply basic SEO principles, including search intent, page structure, titles, metadata, internal links, and calls to action.
  • Review published pages and assets to confirm that content and design render correctly across devices.

Product Release & Internal Enablement Content

  • Support the Director of Product Marketing in preparation and production of internal and external materials for product updates and releases
  • Partner with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to understand content needs and translate them into useful materials, such as internal presentations, training materials, talking points, FAQs, launch briefs, and reference resources.
  • Create customer-facing educational assets that help users understand and adopt OTS features.
  • Audit and update existing materials as products, messaging, positioning, and processes evolve.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, English, Journalism, Design, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in content marketing, copywriting, communications, editorial production, or a related role.
  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills.
  • Experience creating content for multiple formats and audiences.
  • Ability to synthesize information from interviews, briefs, research, and source documents.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to receive, interpret, and incorporate feedback from multiple stakeholders.
  • Clear verbal communication skills and confidence working with subject-matter experts.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and collaborate effectively across teams.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and willingness to learn unfamiliar topics, products, and systems.

Systems & Platform Familiarity

  • Content management systems (we host on HubSpot)
  • Email marketing platforms (we use HubSpot)
  • Design platforms (we use Canva and Figma)
  • Presentation tools (we use Google Slides)
  • Project management and documentation tools (we use Notion)
  • Social media platforms and publishing tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • A portfolio demonstrating strong writing, editing, and content production work.
  • Experience producing B2B SaaS, product marketing, customer education, or demand generation content.
  • Experience creating visual assets, presentation decks, or infographics.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot website, landing page, blog, and email tools.
  • Working knowledge of SEO, web accessibility, and content performance fundamentals.
  • Experience in or a passion for live entertainment, theatre, performing arts, and education a big plus.

How You'll Succeed

  • Content is accurate, useful, on-brand, and delivered on schedule.
  • Demand Gen and Customer Marketing partners consistently have the assets they need to execute their campaigns effectively.
  • Website and product release materials remain current, polished, and consistent.
  • Sales and Customer Success teams receive clear, effective enablement materials for launches and important initiatives.
  • Content projects move smoothly through briefing, drafting, review, design, approval, and publication.
  • Templates, source files, and content libraries are organized and easy for the team to reuse.
  • You continuously improve content processes by documenting what works and addressing recurring production bottlenecks.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

On The Stage (OTS) started in the arts—and we’ve never left. What began as a platform built for theatre makers has grown into the ticketing, marketing, and fundraising engine powering the full spectrum of live entertainment: from K-12 drama programs and community theatres to professional performing arts organizations, comedy clubs, music venues, multi-venue entertainment complexes, immersive experiences, and location-based entertainment.

Founded by Tony and Olivier Award-winning Broadway producer Hunter Arnold alongside Silicon Valley tech veterans, we were built from the inside out by people who came from the arts and understood what was missing. That origin shapes everything: the language we use, the problems we prioritize, and the conviction that every live entertainment producer—non-profit or commercial, a school drama teacher or a West End producer—deserves access to the same infrastructure that powers Broadway.

Today, OTS serves thousands of organizations across the US, non-profits and commercial producers alike. Our all-in-one platform delivers Broadway-caliber infrastructure: ticketing with mobile-first checkout, a native CRM, automated marketing, a full fundraising suite, in-checkout revenue accelerators, and real-time reporting—all sharing a single patron record. Whether the goal is filling seats, cultivating donors, or maximizing revenue per transaction, every feature serves one mission: helping live entertainment organizations endure, expand, and prosper.

We believe in power without complexity—intuitive enough for a solo educator to launch in minutes, sophisticated enough to power the most complex commercial productions. OTS is at a pivotal growth stage, and the marketing infrastructure we build today will directly shape how we reach and serve the next wave of performing arts and live entertainment organizations.

For more information, visit www.OnTheStage.com.

We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

Like to ship meaningful products and generally get things done? As an Infrastructure Engineer on CrowdStrike's TechOps CICD Image Management team, you will be a key contributor to a team of engineers responsible for building, maintaining, and delivering the golden images that power CrowdStrike's software factory at scale. Linux is at the core of our image fleet, with macOS and Windows rounding out a multi-platform pipeline that thousands of daily builds and tests depend on. A core part of this role is contributing to Ceramic, our internal golden-image build platform that automates the full image lifecycle: from upstream OS through hardening, compliance testing, SBOM tracking, and approval workflows before images reach production consumers. jobs.excerpt: About NymbusNymbus is a high-growth fintech company, ‘Built to Move,’ empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace.
jobs.description:
About Nymbus

Nymbus is a high-growth fintech company, ‘Built to Move,’ empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace. At Nymbus, we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work, and the value we deliver to our clients.

We want our partners to be thrilled about the possibilities we are creating together and the lasting impact our collaboration will bring to the industry and consumers. The journey to growth begins with doing something different. And that journey starts with the great people who make Nymbus.

We challenge the status quo, question assumptions, and work together to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.

The Opportunity

Nymbus is seeking a Business Intelligence Architect to lead the data warehouse and reporting transformation for a key financial institution client currently operating on a Microsoft SQL Server data warehouse platform (SQL Server, SSIS, and SSRS). This role will serve as the technical lead guiding the client's migration from its existing Microsoft stack to a modern data platform built on Snowflake (database) and Sigma (analytics and reporting).

The Business Intelligence Architect will maintain and support the client's existing SQL Server-based data warehouse and reporting environment while simultaneously designing, building, and migrating data models, ETL pipelines, and reports to Snowflake and Sigma.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role requiring strong data modeling, database development, and BI/reporting expertise, along with the ability to translate an existing Microsoft-based architecture into an equivalent (and improved) design on the new platform.

You will work both independently and collaboratively with cross-functional partners (including data engineering, product, and client stakeholders) to deliver a well documented, low-disruption transition from the legacy stack to Snowflake and Sigma, while keeping existing reporting and data operations running smoothly throughout the migration.

What You Will Own

Legacy Platform Support & Data Architecture

  • Understand database design methodologies and assist in the design, implementation, and maintenance of data models using data modeling tools (Sparx, Oxygen, Altova, Erwin, etc.).
  • Develop and document ETL data flows using SSIS, PowerShell, PowerPoint, Visio, and T-SQL to support the client's existing SQL Server environment.
  • Use the Microsoft technology stack (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio) to support application and operations systems throughout the transition period.
  • Create new and manage existing reports, dashboards, and agents in the Business Intelligence system (SSRS) to ensure timely and accurate data reporting for use by bank managers for decision-making purposes.

Snowflake & Sigma Migration Leadership

  • Serve as the lead technical architect for converting the client's data warehouse and reporting environment from SQL Server/SSIS/SSRS to Snowflake and Sigma.
  • Design target-state data models in Snowflake that faithfully translate (and where appropriate, improve upon) the client's existing SQL Server schemas and data relationships.
  • Re-engineer existing SSIS-based ETL data flows into Snowflake-native ingestion and transformation pipelines.
  • Rebuild existing SSRS reports and dashboards as equivalent Sigma workbooks and reports, validating parity in logic, output, and accuracy against the legacy versions.
  • Document source-to-target mappings for both data integration and report output (covering mappings from SQL Server to Snowflake and from SSRS to Sigma) in a form that reporting team members and client stakeholders can easily understand.
  • Sequence and coordinate the migration to minimize disruption to the client's ongoing reporting and data operations, including planning cutover phases and parallel-run validation.

Collaboration, Communication & Support

  • Communicate proactively with team members and client stakeholders about potential system issues, migration risk, and status. Support off-hours upgrade and/or migration work when necessary.
  • Actively participate in data and application development peer reviews, interdepartmental requirements-gathering sessions, troubleshooting, and project support.
  • Identify data inconsistencies, anomalies, and scripting issues to support increasing overall system performance through code/script reviews, and develop and implement recommendations accordingly.
  • Ensure end-user issues are identified, tracked, reported on, and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Complete all yearly compliance training and testing, and comply with bank, Federal,and State regulations. Adhere to departmental and bank-wide service standards.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of relevant experience for this role.
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in a traditional financial institution (bank or credit union).
  • Excellent attention to detail, data accuracy, and quality of output.
  • Proficient in the areas of statistics, finance, and retail and commercial banking business concepts.
  • Passion to self-educate and stay current on the latest analytics and data platform trends in marketing, banking, and other fields, including modern cloud data warehousing and BI tools.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills to articulate effectively in forums and meetings with technical and non-technical teams, and to explain migration decisions and trade-offs clearly to client stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide clear and concise project documentation to various stakeholders, including source-to-target mapping and migration plans.
  • Strong time management skills, with proficiency in prioritizing, scheduling, and managing multiple project schedules and differing levels of criticality across legacy support and migration work.
  • Proficient in the Microsoft Development and Office Suite.
  • Proficient in the areas of application development (programming), database and system/application design. Knowledge of legacy and web-based systems and intrinsic interfaces (WebAPI, TCP, UDP, Database, etc.).
  • Legacy platform: SQL Server; SSIS, SSRS, SSAS.
  • Target platform: Snowflake; Sigma.
  • Visio, Lucid.
  • Data modeling: Sparx, Oxygen, Altova, Erwin, SQL Developer (Oracle), SQL Data Modeler (Oracle).
  • Reporting and Integration frameworks: Sigma, Tableau, Power BI, SSRS, SSIS.
  • Visual Studio VB and/or C# — software development (Web, WinForm, Services, API, WebAPI).

How We Work

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Success in our remote environment requires self-motivation, initiative, and strong personal accountability. Team members are expected to manage their priorities independently, communicate proactively, remain responsive, and participate on camera during virtual meetings.

A strong remote culture requires intentional effort from everyone. We expect team members to engage in our global community, proactively build relationships, participate actively in team and company conversations, seek opportunities to collaborate, and take shared ownership of creating a connected and inclusive remote community including showing up on camera.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary range: $135,000 to $150,000 annually
  • Annual cash bonus and equity eligibility, if applicable.
  • Remote Work Environment
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, including HSA/FSA/DCA
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible time-off and company holidays
  • Additional paid volunteer day
  • Supplemental Insurance Programs, including voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs [EAP]
  • Wellness programs
  • Growth and development programs

Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, role scope, and location.

Hiring at Nymbus

As an AI-first company, we embrace the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools available to us today, including AI-enabled video interview tools, we remain equally committed to maintaining human involvement and oversight throughout the hiring process.

Nymbus is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Nymbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process, including accommodations related to our use of AI tools. If you require an accommodation, please notify your recruiter.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the position is based. This role is currently based in the United States. Not all locations are available for consideration, and locations will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, this posting includes the anticipated base salary range, a general description of available benefits, and the application deadline where required. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and location.

Ready to join? We invite you to watch this video and learn who we are and how we build and innovates together!

jobs.title: Consultancy: Research on Chinese environmental, social, and governance managemen
jobs.excerpt: The International Institute for Sustainable Development (IISD) is a globally recognized think tank with more than 30 years of experience working to solve today's greatest sustainable development challenges.
locationRestrictions: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the
jobs.description:
The International Institute for Sustainable Development (IISD) is a globally recognized think tank with more than 30 years of experience working to solve today's greatest sustainable development challenges. We combine deep expertise across critical policy areas with a collaborative approach to research, advice, and hands-on support that delivers real-world results. Headquartered in Winnipeg, Manitoba, we are a diverse team of over 300 experts working from offices in Canada and Switzerland as well as other locations around the world.

1. Background

Critical minerals are necessary inputs for the technologies essential for the energy and digital transitions that will shape the low-carbon economies of the future. At the same time, mining activities can generate significant environmental and social impacts that need to be managed, including water pollution, waste generation, biodiversity loss, labour concerns, and community grievances. As a global leader in processing critical minerals and manufacturing technologies for energy and digital transitions, China plays a decisive role in shaping how these transitions would be managed. Namely, the environmental, social, and governance (ESG) compliance and business practices of Chinese mining and mineral processing companies can lead to important sustainable development outcomes.

IISD has conducted research on the evolving Chinese ESG framework and standards in critical mineral value chains and its application to overseas operations of Chinese companies, using the nickel value chain in Indonesia as a case study. In a second phase of this research, IISD will delve deeper into the ESG practices of Chinese copper and cobalt mining and mineral processing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The study will assess the ESG practices of selected Chinese-invested mining and processing operations in the DRC, identify areas of progress and remaining gaps, and examine how Chinese regulatory frameworks, DRC mining governance, and international sustainability standards interact in practice. The project will generate evidence-based recommendations and facilitate dialogue among Chinese stakeholders, international standards bodies, governments, industry, and civil society.

2. Purpose of the Consultancy

IISD seeks a consultant to conduct research and draft a chapter of the study on the ESG management practices of Chinese copper and cobalt mining and processing companies operating in the DRC, as well as the engagement models between Chinese actors and international ESG standard-setting bodies.

The consultant will conduct desk research and stakeholder interviews, as needed, to provide an analysis of the state of ESG performance and practices of Chinese copper and cobalt mining and processing companies operating in the DRC. This will include a comparative analysis of the ESG management practices of Chinese companies compared with other major actors operating in the country, as well as the change in ESG management over time (in the last 10–20 years), including the experience of Chinese companies’ engagement with international ESG standards. In addition, the chapter will provide an analysis of the evolution of the engagement and cooperation between Chinese and international ESG standards-setting bodies.

Findings from the research should give a comparative analysis (comparing change over time and in practices of major mining companies and mineral processors in the DRC) of the current state of ESG management practices of Chinese copper and cobalt mining and processing companies operating in the DRC. It should also provide an analysis of the wider engagement of Chinese and international standards bodies, looking into how collaborative arrangements work in practice, what are the different engagement models and avenues, and what are their limitations and potential opportunities for the future. The findings should inform recommendations on how to improve the ESG performance of Chinese copper and cobalt companies in the DRC.

3. Objectives

3.1 Overall Objectives

The objective of this consultancy is to research and draft a chapter on the ESG management practices of Chinese copper and cobalt mining and processing companies operating in the DRC and on the engagement models between Chinese actors and international ESG standard-setting bodies.

3.2 Specific Objectives

The consultant will deliver a chapter for the report that will include the following:

  • An analysis of the ESG management practices of Chinese companies operating in the DRC’s copper and cobalt value chain and the remaining challenges they face. The analysis should provide some comparison on the ESG performance of Chinese companies over time (in the last 10–20 years) and compare the ESG management practices of Chinese companies with other major companies in these industries (supplemented by research from the team).
  • An analytical overview of the engagement models between Chinese standards-setting bodies (e.g., China Chamber of Commerce of Metals, Minerals & Chemicals Importers & Exporters (CCCMC)) and international standards-setting bodies (e.g., The Initiative for Responsible Minning Assurance (IRMA), Responsible Minerals Initiative (RMI), the Copper Mark, etc.). The analysis should provide first-hand insights, corroborated by stakeholder interviews, into current engagement arrangements, their scope of work, operationalization in practice, and analysis of the potential and limitations for these types of engagement arrangements in terms of improving ESG performance.
  • Comprehensive documentation of primary data collected for the analysis, anonymized and aggregated where required. A summary report of the relevant stakeholder interviews that captures perspectives from government agencies, industry associations, standards-setting bodies, mining companies, and civil society, including the local communities directly affected by mining and mineral processing.
  • Recommendations on how to improve ESG practices of Chinese copper and cobalt mining and processing companies in the DRC.

4. Scope of Work

  • Conduct desk-based research.
  • Review relevant policy documents, academic literature, and industry reports.
  • Participate in inception discussions with the project team.
  • Prepare a detailed chapter outline for approval.
  • Draft the chapter, including complete citations and references to secondary sources and primary data to back up all relevant findings.
  • Revise the chapter based on reviewer comments.
  • Participate in review meetings as required.

5. Deliverables

  • Inception note: A 2–3-page note describing the methodology, research approach, and proposed chapter structure.
  • Annotated chapter outline: A detailed outline with major arguments and evidence sources.
  • Summary report of stakeholder interviews: A summary report of all the stakeholder interviews conducted for the chapter
  • First draft: Complete chapter draft
  • Final draft: Revised chapter incorporating comments

6. Expected Length and Format

  • Estimated chapter length: 3,000 words.
  • Written in clear, professional English.
  • Referencing style: APA 7th Edition.
  • All data sources must be cited.
  • Graphics, tables, and figures should be supplied in editable format where possible.

7. Expected Timeline

  • Contract start: November 1, 2026
  • Inception note: November 10, 2026
  • Outline approved: November 15, 2026
  • Summary report of stakeholder interviews: February 15, 2027
  • First draft: March 15, 2027
  • Comments returned: April 15, 2027
  • Final draft: May 15, 2027

8. Required Qualifications

Qualifications

  • A master’s degree in law, social sciences, public policy, environment, development studies, or a relevant interdisciplinary program or field. Applicants without a master’s degree are welcome to apply if they can demonstrate equivalent experience.

Experience

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in mining governance, mining policy, ESG management, sustainable development, or related fields, with a demonstrated focus on China and Chinese companies.
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to or independently delivering research, analysis, and policy recommendations related to mining and sustainable development.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting multistakeholder consultations as part of policy research.
  • Experience working with and access to Chinese mining companies and/or Chinese ESG standards-setting bodies is desirable.

Technical Skills

  • Strong analytical and writing skills, with the ability to synthesize information into clear, well-structured outputs.
  • Working knowledge of policy research methods, including qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis.
  • Strong, demonstrated knowledge and work experience with China’s legal and regulatory ESG framework related to the mining and mineral processing industry.
  • Familiarity with international ESG standards-setting bodies and their implementation processes.
  • Familiarity with sustainable development, policy theory, and current climate and energy policy issues is highly desirable; willingness and ability to learn in these areas are essential.
  • Computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office/Teams, and experience using web-based communications and collaboration tools. Ability to work on shared documents in Microsoft 365 environments is a technical requirement.
  • Fluency in English and Chinese (required). Knowledge of French is an advantage (desired).

Location: Remote (with possible travel to the DRC).

IISD will not be applying for residency, and work permits for this position on behalf of the applicant.

9. Proposal Requirements

Applicants are requested to submit a brief inception approach outlining their proposed methodology, data sources, analytical framework, and a draft chapter structure. The proposed approach will be assessed as part of the technical evaluation.

Interested consultants should submit the following:

Technical Proposal

Maximum 5 pages including

  • understanding of the assignment
  • proposed methodology and research approach
  • proposed chapter outline
  • work plan and timeline
  • relevant experience

Financial Proposal

  • Daily rate and estimated level of effort for the entire consultancy

Supporting Materials

  • CV
  • Two relevant writing samples
  • Contact information for references (optional)

Application Process

Application deadline: October 19, 2026 4PM CST

NOTE:

  • All applications must be submitted in English.
  • Incomplete and late proposals will be automatically disqualified.

Experience, Education, and Certifications

jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

As our Senior Payment Integrity Program Development Manager, you will serve as the primary clinical architect and inventor behind Devoted’s clinical claim edit and audit pipeline. Operating in a high-autonomy, outcomes-driven individual contributor role, you will conduct independent clinical research, interpret specialty society guidelines, and analyze multi-setting billing data to originate brand-new, automated payment integrity logic from scratch.

While complex, high-dollar inpatient care forms a critical foundation of this role, you will also apply your clinical acumen across outpatient, Ambulatory Surgical Center (ASC), and professional settings to ensure a continuous, high-impact pipeline of payment integrity concepts.

Your responsibilities and impact will include:

  • Greenfield Concept Ideation: Drive ground-up innovation by researching clinical literature, specialty society guidelines, and multi-setting billing trends (Inpatient, Outpatient, ASC, and Professional) to identify hidden payment anomalies and formulate original edit hypotheses.

  • Primary Logic Architecture: Author end-to-end logics from scratch. Translate raw clinical documentation, medical policies, and facility/professional coding frameworks (MS-DRG, APR-DRG, APC/OPPS, ASC packaging, and CPT/HCPCS rules) into precise, automated logic parameters.

  • Data Hypothesis Validation: Perform primary data analysis (utilizing modern AI tools for SQL query generation) to test your clinical hypotheses across clinical settings, prove financial viability on real-world datasets, and design parameters that prevent provider abrasion.

  • Cross-Functional Policy Leadership: Pitch your original clinical concepts to directors and executive stakeholders; drive consensus across Clinical Operations, SIU, Claims, and Legal to approve novel policy interpretations and rule architectures.

  • End-to-End Concept Ownership: Lead multi-phased concept rollouts across clinical settings—from initial clinical discovery through selection criteria, logic testing, post-launch tuning, and long-term performance tracking.

Required skills and experience:

  • Clinical & Coding Credentials: An active Registered Nurse (RN) license with direct inpatient clinical experience (e.g., ICU, Med-Surg) AND an active professional coding certification (e.g., CPC, CCS, CCS-P, or RHIA).

  • Net-New Concept Authoring: 5+ years of experience in payment integrity where you were the primary author and creator of net-new claim edits within a health plan or vendor setting (as opposed to evaluating pre-built edit catalogs or executing client implementation requests).

  • Medicare & Regulatory Foundation: Expert understanding of core Medicare rules, billing regulations, Local/National Coverage Determinations (LCDs/NCDs), and NCCI edit logic across care settings.

  • Multi-Setting Clinical & Facility Mastery: Deep working knowledge of facility and professional billing dynamics, including inpatient (MS-DRG/APR-DRG), outpatient/ASC (APC/OPPS, fee schedules), and professional CPT/HCPCS clinical guidelines.

  • Hands-On Logic Writing: Direct experience authoring detailed rules and structural logic specifications for implementation in commercial claims editing engines (e.g., Optum/CES, Cotiviti, McKesson) or payer proprietary/internal rules platforms.

  • Research & Data Literacy: Proven ability to synthesize complex clinical specialty guidelines into structured logic, paired with the analytical ability to read, interpret, and validate data queries (SQL assistance provided via modern AI tools).

  • Senior-Level Influence: Exceptional narrative and framing skills with a track record of building cross-functional alignment around complex, original technical concepts.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Specialized experience applying rules and coverage determinations specifically within a Medicare Advantage (MA) managed care environment.

  • Familiarity with using AI workflows, large language models (LLMs), or automated pattern-matching tools to accelerate data analysis, literature review, and rule development.

Salary range: $110,500 - $150,000 / year

We serve companies that rely on precise formulations and material composition to determine product performance, safety, and regulatory compliance for their chemical products. For those producing physical products at scale, we help ensure that ingredients, materials, and formulations drive quality, consistency, speed-to-market, and margin. Our solutions are also vital for companies developing energy products or managing energy assets, where throughput, recovery, and operational reliability directly impact revenue and asset economics.

In this role, you will combine advanced AI/ML approaches with your domain expertise to build models that solve complex industrial problems, optimize processes, and drive real-world breakthroughs. You will work closely with domain experts, product teams, and engineers to translate scientific problems into scalable AI solutions that drive measurable business and customer impact.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLENatera is seeking a product engineering leader to build and lead the team that designs, delivers, and operates domain data products and AI-enabled analytical solutions on NDP (Natera Data Platform).
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Natera is seeking a product engineering leader to build and lead the team that designs, delivers, and operates domain data products and AI-enabled analytical solutions on NDP (Natera Data Platform). You will report to the Head of Data & AI and partner with platform, governance, and product functions to turn data needs into certified, production-grade data and analytics products.

Natera follows a data mesh architecture with headless data products: domain-owned assets, not tied to any BI layer, built for both human and AI consumption. A data product is ready when it is semantically correct and AI-ready, not just numerically accurate. Your mandate is to make that standard repeatable across every domain while transforming how the team works: AI-native, 3–5x more productive, and self-service for the business.

Please note that this is role focuses on product side of data engineering (not platform). This person needs to demonstrate their ability to

(a) Build a self-service analytics product experience for business users and

(b) Create a catalog of AI ready gold-standard cross functional data products

(c) Create an operating model focusing on reusability, speed. and business value of data

that scale beyond one business domain.

Critical Priorities for This Role

  • Standardize and scale how data products are built — one publishing standard, golden paths, and a common operating model across every domain.
  • Make the team AI-native — agentic SDLC and AI-assisted development become how everyone works resulting in higher productivity and growth opportunities
  • Deliver a 3–5x productivity gain — instrumented with baselines and delivery KPIs, not anecdotes.
  • Raise data product quality — semantically correct, AI-ready, observable, ship-ready data products.
  • Make analytics self-service — certified, discoverable products that business users and AI systems consume without an engineering queue.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Own Data Product Delivery

  • Lead the build of cross functional data products, analytics experiences, and Golden KPI's that are essential to making data driven decisions across the business
  • Create the operating model to deliver analytics to business users by leveraging embedded data/AI engineers with each business domain.
  • Track and report delivery KPIs: time-to-delivery, certified dataset count, adoption by consuming teams, open production incidents.

2. Standardize & Scale How Data Products Are Built for Analytics and AI use

  • Define and enforce the publishing standard for analytics products: semantically correct, AI-ready, lineage documented, ownership assigned, catalog entry complete.
  • Establish the headless data product standard: domain-owned assets any authorized consumer — dashboard, workflow, or AI system — can use.
  • Build golden paths (templates, examples, documented patterns) so every product starts from a known-good baseline, and make this the operating model for intake, build, certification, and support.

3. Build an AI-Native Engineering Competency

  • Drive agentic data engineering as the default: agentic SDLC, AI pipeline generation, agents writing and validating dbt models, AI-driven testing, LLM tools in code review and documentation.
  • Train every engineer to work AI-natively and redefine the working model — SDLC steps, roles, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, definition of done.
  • Own a measurable plan to lift productivity 3–5x: baseline throughput and cycle time, instrument each change, report outcomes.

4. Raise the Data Product Quality Bar

  • Enforce engineering standards on every production solution: CI/CD for pipelines, infrastructure as code, data observability, data quality frameworks.
  • Implement agentic data quality: automated drift detection, root-cause identification, human-in-the-loop recovery.
  • Meet HIPAA, RAQA, and data classification requirements at design time. If a product does not meet the bar, it does not ship.

5. Make Data Self-Service for Humans and AI

  • Own the NDP contribution and discovery model: what gets published, how it is documented, and how human and AI consumers find and evaluate certified assets.
  • Ensure every catalog entry carries semantic metadata and AI-readiness classification so business users and AI agents answer their own questions without an engineering ticket.
  • Partner with the Data Governance Lead to embed data contracts, certification review, and access policy into the lifecycle so self-service is safe and correctly scoped.

6. Lead the Team and Set the Technical Bar

  • Hire, coach, and grow data and analytics engineers; set clear expectations, give direct feedback, build real career paths.
  • Stay hands-on: review architecture and code, debug production failures, and set the standard by example across Snowflake, AWS, Claude, Sigma, dbt, Fivetran, Python, and Airflow.
  • Be the engineering face of data products to business stakeholders: translate ambiguous needs into scoped, time-bound commitments; when things change, communicate early with a plan.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • 10+ years in data engineering, 5+ leading data or analytics engineering teams at Director level.
  • Hands-on depth: you write and review Python and SQL, critique dbt models, debug pipeline failures, and make architecture calls yourself.
  • Shipped data products to production with measurable adoption. You can name the products, who used them, and what changed.
  • Regulated-environment delivery (healthcare, life sciences, diagnostics, pharma) with PHI and real HIPAA compliance experience.
  • Modern data stack: Snowflake, AWS, Claude, dbt, Fivetran, Sigma, orchestrator such as Airflow or Dagster; CI/CD for data pipelines and infrastructure as code.
  • Working knowledge of data mesh and headless, domain-owned data products built for human and AI consumers.
  • Built or led teams using AI-assisted development in production: agents, code generation, AI-driven testing and validation.
  • Defined engineering standards, golden paths, or operating models that scaled across multiple teams or domains.
  • Strong communicator: runs a stakeholder review, writes a technical proposal, represents engineering with executives.

Nice to Have

  • Diagnostics, genomics, or clinical data engineering (BAM, VCF, FASTQ).
  • Vector databases, embeddings, or RAG architectures in a data engineering context.
  • Data contracts as engineering artifacts: schema enforcement, versioning, change management.
  • Rolled out enterprise agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code) to an engineering org, including training and change management.

This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly.
