Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner at Blackbird Health, you'll play an essential role in delivering comprehensive psychiatric evaluations, treatment planning, and medication management for children, adolescents, and young adults. You'll build meaningful connections with patients to support their engagement in treatment, spending the necessary time with patients and families to understand their needs, educate them about care options, and provide ongoing support. You'll ensure patients are making progress against their care goals and take the necessary steps to keep our patients safe. Working alongside an interdisciplinary team, you'll be empowered to make a tangible difference in the lives of young patients and their families. This remote role requires a minimum of 10 hours per week.

What makes you, you:

  • Mission-Driven: You are passionate about transforming behavioral health for youth and committed to delivering high-quality, compassionate psychiatric care.
  • Clinically Excellent: You have experience working with children and adolescents as a psychiatric nurse practitioner and have practiced independently at the top of your scope for at least two years under licensure. You bring clinical expertise with a warm, patient-centered approach.
  • Relationship-Focused: You excel at building meaningful connections with patients and families, taking the time to understand their needs, provide education, and create a trusting therapeutic relationship that supports engagement in treatment.
  • Collaborative: You thrive in team-based environments and love working alongside psychotherapists, specialists, and interdisciplinary colleagues to deliver integrated, comprehensive care.
  • Growth-Oriented: You are open to feedback and eager to learn and grow in a supportive clinical community where best practices and professional development are prioritized.
  • Tech-Savvy: You are comfortable using technology, including Google Suite, Electronic Medical Records systems and other virtual platforms to deliver seamless virtual and in-person care.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Provide Comprehensive Psychiatric Care: Conduct thorough psychiatric evaluations, assessments, and diagnoses for children, adolescents, and young adults. Develop personalized treatment plans and provide medication management that addresses the unique needs of each patient.
  • Build Meaningful Therapeutic Relationships: Spend the necessary time with patients and families to truly understand their experiences, educate them about treatment options, and provide ongoing support. Build connection and trust that keeps patients engaged in their care journey.
  • Drive Patient Progress & Safety: Monitor patient progress against care goals, adjusting treatment plans as needed to ensure positive outcomes. Take the necessary steps to keep patients safe, intervening proactively when concerns arise.
  • Collaborate for Integrated Care: Work closely with therapists and other healthcare professionals to create integrated treatment plans that address the whole child. Communicate and engage with families when appropriate to ensure coordinated, high-quality care.
  • Educate & Empower Families: Provide consultation and education to patients and their families, helping them understand diagnoses, treatment options, and how to support their child's mental health journey.
  • Ensure Clinical Excellence & Compliance: Oversee diagnostic testing including digital and lab results. Partner with administrative team to handle refills, prior authorizations, records, and rescheduling. Maintain thorough, HIPAA-compliant patient records and documentation.

The basics you'll need:

  • Active PMHNP license in Maryland
  • A minimum of 2 years experience working independently in the role of a psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner
  • A minimum of 1 year experience working with children, adolescents or young adults under any nursing license
  • Board Certification by ANCC or AANP (PMHNP-BC)
  • DEA license and State Prescriptive Authority License
  • Autonomous Practice Status
  • Computer, phone and high speed internet
  • Experience with Google Suite, EHR systems and tech knowledge
  • Commit to a minimum of 10 hours per week.

Why Blackbird is unique:

  • Full credentialing services provided - we will take care of everything
  • Clinical development and trainings
  • Excellent administrative support - focus on the clinical work and we will take care of the rest
  • Weekly clinical consultations: this is paid time for all providers
  • Supportive work culture
  • Liability Insurance
  • Reimbursement for client no-shows
Salary Range
$120—$140 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

We're looking for a Senior Cyber Security Operations Analyst to design, build, and scale secure enterprise development and QA environments across Azure-based software delivery ecosystems. You'll enhance Azure DevOps platform capabilities, improve CI/CD pipeline architecture, and integrate security throughout the software development lifecycle. This role works closely with Engineering, QA, Release Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Product Security teams to improve build reliability, deployment consistency, and operational efficiency.

We care deeply about inclusive working practices and diverse teams. If you'd prefer to work full- time, part-time or as a job-share, we'll facilitate this wherever we can - whether to help you meet other commitments or to help you strike a great work-life balance.

About

At Holiday Extras, we’re creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, build their careers and reach their limitless potential. As a Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025, we’re proud to offer a world of benefits designed to enhance your lifestyle and well-being. By joining our team, you’ll feel supported and rewarded every day.

As Property Surveyor, you will play a key role in supporting HX Group’s property strategy across the UK. This is a broad role combining property acquisition and asset management, with a primary focus on identifying and securing new sites, alongside managing the existing portfolio.

You will help identify, assess, negotiate, and deliver new property opportunities, while also ensuring that existing assets within the portfolio are effectively managed and aligned with business needs. The role will be especially important in supporting the continued growth of Holiday Extras and Airparks’ direct operations, partner subletting opportunities, and wider expansion across the UK.

This isn't a typical property role. You'll be out in the market finding the next locations for Holiday Extras and Airparks, building relationships, assessing opportunities and turning them into commercially strong deals. We're looking for an entrepreneurial, commercially driven and relationship-led candidate - someone hands-on and deal-hungry, who can help shape and drive our expansion journey from the ground up. You'll be comfortable picking up the phone, building relationships from scratch, and turning opportunities into signed deals. In short: a self-sufficient operator with strong property instincts, the commercial nous to evaluate and negotiate complex deals, and the drive to grow a portfolio.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working across the full property lifecycle, from sourcing and negotiating new sites to managing existing assets and driving long-term value.

This is a remote, field-based role where you’ll spend much of your time out across the UK, getting close to the market, building relationships and finding new property opportunities. We’re looking for someone who enjoys being out there - meeting operators, agents and landowners, exploring potential sites and creating opportunities rather than waiting for them to appear.

When you’re not on the road, you’ll work remotely from home, with occasional travel to our HQ in Hythe, Kent for important meetings and team collaboration.

The Role

What you’ll be doing

  • Identify and evaluate new property opportunities across the UK in line with HX Group’s growth strategy
  • Assess and pursue land and site purchases from existing operators, as well as leasehold opportunities, to support Holiday Extras and Airparks' expansion across the UK
  • Lead and support acquisition activity, including site sourcing, due diligence, financial evaluation, negotiation, and deal execution
  • Manage and optimise a portfolio of existing property assets to ensure strong commercial and operational performance
  • Support the expansion of Airparks through the acquisition of strategically valuable locations
  • Work on opportunities to generate additional value through partner subletting and profit rent arrangements
  • Build strong operational relationships with landlords, agents, partners, legal advisors, planners and other external stakeholders, including competitors
  • Use your relationships to build and maintain localised knowledge and a deep understanding of the market at key airport locations
  • Support lease negotiations, renewals, rent reviews, and wider property-related commercial discussions
  • Monitor asset performance and identify opportunities to improve value, efficiency, and return on investment
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders across operations, finance, legal, and commercial teams to ensure property decisions support wider business goals
  • Navigate local market conditions, regulations, and compliance requirements
  • Provide insight, reporting, and recommendations to support strategic property planning and decision-making

What we’re looking for

  • A genuine entrepreneurial mindset - someone who's comfortable picking up the phone, building relationships from scratch, and getting deals done through conversations as much as formal processes.
  • Experience in property, real estate, asset management, acquisitions, or estate management
  • Strong understanding of both property acquisition and ongoing asset/portfolio management
  • Proven ability to negotiate commercial property deals and manage stakeholder relationships effectively
  • Strong commercial and financial awareness, including asset valuation, lease terms, and investment logic
  • Experience working across multiple markets or jurisdictions would be a strong advantage
  • Ability to manage a varied workload across strategic projects and operational property matters
  • Confident communicator with strong relationship-building skills
  • Confident presenting property opportunities, commercial insights and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess opportunities and risks clearly
  • Experience in airport-related assets, parking, mobility, travel, or operational real estate would be advantageous
  • MRICS qualification or similar professional property qualification would be beneficial, but is not essential depending on experience

Everyone’s career path is individual and different, so this is just a guide. If your experience doesn't precisely match this, you’re encouraged to apply so that we can discover your unique talents!

How we hire for this role

We know your time is precious, so we keep our recruitment process as quick and easy as possible. If we believe you might be a match for a job you’ve applied for, you’ll enter our hiring process as follows:

  • Remote intro call with Recruiter and UK Acquisitions Surveyor. This is an opportunity for us to learn more about the skills and experience you’d bring to the role, as well as for you to learn more about the role and our mission.
  • Assessment and interview with Group Property Director

Cultivating a diverse and inclusive culture is paramount for us.

Recognising we are all different, if for whatever reason you need us to adapt the process, please get in touch via .

Please note: this role is not eligible for UK skilled worker visa sponsorship, so we can only consider applicants who already have the right to work in the UK.

Why choose Holiday Extras?

We believe that holidays are the most precious time of all, so we create products, tech and services that make travel and holidays memorable and fun. We’re on a mission to be the only place to go for your holiday extras, offering unparalleled choice, value and service, turning our customers’ ordinary trips into extraordinarily good times.

Our campus is in Newingreen, in the heart of the Kent countryside - just minutes from Folkestone and the M20, where in person connection and collaboration is at the heart of how we work. You'll find free parking, an on-site café, and a state of the art campus that makes the commute worth it.

At Holiday Extras, we’re creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, build their careers and reach their limitless potential. As a Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025, we’re proud to offer a world of benefits designed to enhance your lifestyle and well-being. By joining our team, you’ll feel supported and rewarded every day. Learn more about our culture and benefits.

  • Time is precious: 25 days annual leave (+BH’s), extra holidays through Holiday Buy, Birthday Day Off, and Sabbaticals at each milestone.
  • Parental Leave: Enhanced parental leave - Up to 1 year off, including 13 weeks at 100% pay, 13 weeks at 50% pay

Are you a curiosity driven technologist who can quickly understand how an AI system works, identify where it could be misused or fail, and help a team find a practical path forward? Role Summary:

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of modern AI technology, security risk, architecture, and enablement. You will conduct AI security reviews using SIE’s established security risk assessment methodology, policies, standards, and control expectations, adapting their application to AI-enabled and agentic systems and identifying where AI-specific guidance or controls are needed. You will coordinate risk-focused design and architecture input and translate AI-specific weaknesses into decision-ready recommendations and engineering actions.

You will serve as an approachable security partner, working cross-functionally with teams across SIE’s business units and functions to support a diverse range of AI use cases, systems, and technologies. You will work especially closely with Responsible AI & Governance and coordinate expertise across Information Security teams and IT & Engineering organizations.

This is a highly collaborative, fast-moving role for someone who enjoys working directly with teams, navigating ambiguity, and using AI tools themselves. You will be the primary hands-on practitioner in an emerging AI Security capability, partnering with the AI Security strategy lead and specialist teams across SIE.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead hands-on security risk reviews of AI use cases and systems from early design through launch readiness.

  • Serve as a trusted security partner by providing early consultation, education, and reusable guidance.
  • Coordinate with Responsible AI & Governance, relevant security and technical teams to deliver consistent, well-informed reviews.
  • Use security tooling and discovery insights to identify emerging risks, engage owners, and support appropriate remediation. Document reviews and findings within SIE GRC systems.
  • Improve AI security requirements, review practices, reference patterns, and supporting tools as technologies and risks evolve.

  • 6+ years of experience building, integrating, assessing, or securing technical systems, including significant recent hands-on work with generative AI.

  • Sound understanding of security fundamentals - including identity, permissions, data protection, integrations, and monitoring – and ability to apply these to AI-enabled and agentic systems as well as mapping back to existing security policies and frameworks.
  • A practical builder mindset, with experience using AI tools, APIs, cloud services, code, or automation to explore systems and improve workflows.
  • Proven ability to build trust and influence across engineering, product, creative, business, and security teams.
  • Familiarity and ability to stay current with emerging AI technologies, evolving security risks, AI risk frameworks, and industry trends.
  • Strong communication, empathy, and sound judgment, with the creativity to challenge assumptions, navigate ambiguity, and build trust while operating independently in a fast-moving environment.

Desirable:

  • Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, threat modeling, or security evaluations of LLM and agentic systems.
  • Experience with cloud-based AI platforms, third-party AI services, or enterprise security tooling.
  • Experience in gaming, interactive entertainment, creator technology, or similarly innovative product environments.
  • Experience reviewing complex technical designs and translating identified weaknesses into practical, prioritized recommendations that support timely delivery.
  • Relevant certifications are desirable and may include GIAC AI Platform Security (GAIPS), CISSP, CRISC, IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP), CCSK, CCSP, or equivalent AI, cloud, or security credentials.

jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

jobs.description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

Sphera is seeking a QA Manager to lead quality assurance across multiple product lines and concurrent projects. This role owns QA execution and team leadership, ensuring high-quality releases while driving consistent testing practices and continuous improvement across squads.

This is a hands-on management role: you'll lead a team of QA engineers, coordinate closely with Engineering Managers, Product Owners, and cross-functional stakeholders, and be accountable for the quality outcomes of your product lines' releases.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of QA engineers across multiple product lines, providing coaching, performance feedback, and career development
  • Allocate QA resources across concurrent projects and sprints based on release priorities and risk
  • Foster a culture of quality ownership and continuous improvement within the team

Quality Strategy & Execution

  • Own the QA strategy and test planning across your assigned product lines, including functional, regression, and release testing
  • Define and maintain risk-based test coverage that balances thoroughness with delivery speed
  • Ensure test automation is appropriately invested in and maintained, avoiding over-reliance on UI/E2E tests where lower-level coverage is more effective
  • Drive clarity on QA vs. Engineering ownership boundaries within squads

Automation & AI-Driven Quality Transformation

  • Lead the transition from manual to automated testing across your teams, building automation into sprint delivery rather than treating it as a post-sprint add-on
  • Assess, prioritize, and manage automation investment across squads with differing tech stacks and maturity levels
  • Build and grow team capability in automation practices through coaching, upskilling, and hands-on guidance
  • Champion the organization's move toward an AI-driven development lifecycle (AI DLC), identifying where AI-assisted testing, test generation, and quality tooling can accelerate coverage and reduce manual effort
  • Partner with QA leadership to pilot and scale AI-assisted QA practices within your product lines, balancing innovation with reliability and maintainability

Release & Process Management

  • Manage QA activities across the full release lifecycle for your product lines, including regression cycles and release sign-off
  • Partner with Engineering Managers to ensure developer involvement in testing activities, particularly during regression windows
  • Identify and address structural gaps in QA process (e.g., automation tasks planned as sprint deliverables, not post-sprint additions)
  • Support incident and defect triage, ensuring timely resolution and root-cause follow-up

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the primary QA point of contact for your product lines, working closely with Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and other stakeholders
  • Communicate quality status, risks, and release readiness clearly to stakeholders at varying levels of technical depth
  • Collaborate with QA leadership on company-wide initiatives (e.g., automation standards, shift-left practices) and ensure consistent adoption across your product lines

Reporting & Metrics

  • Track and report on quality metrics (defect trends, test coverage, regression outcomes) for your product lines
  • Escalate risks and blockers proactively, with clear, non-blaming, solution-oriented communication

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of experience in software QA, including 2+ years in a QA leadership or team management role
  • Experience managing QA across multiple products or projects simultaneously
  • Demonstrated experience leading a team's transition from manual to automated testing, including planning, tooling decisions, and change management
  • Strong understanding of test automation principles and the test pyramid; ability to guide teams away from over-indexing on UI/E2E automation
  • Working knowledge of or genuine interest in AI-assisted development and testing practices, with an eye toward adopting AI DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) approaches
  • Experience working with heterogeneous or legacy tech stacks (a plus, given Sphera's mix of acquired-company platforms)
  • Familiarity with risk-based testing and regression planning for enterprise SaaS products
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills — comfortable presenting quality status to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or similar test/work management tooling
  • Domain familiarity with risk management or compliance software is a plus, but not required

What Sets This Role Apart

  • Direct ownership of quality outcomes across multiple active, evolving product lines
  • Close collaboration with senior QA leadership driving a broader shift-left quality transformation across Sphera
  • Opportunity to shape team structure, automation direction, and testing practices for growing squads

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Who we are:

We’re Cart.com, one of the fastest growing commerce enablement companies in the world. We provide the digital and physical infrastructure that empowers thousands of leading B2C, B2B and public sector organizations to unify commerce operations from product discovery to product delivery.

We’re building toward a world where commerce has no bounds. Our enterprise-grade software, services and logistics infrastructure, including our own network of omnichannel fulfillment and distribution centers, enable merchants to navigate an increasingly complex operating landscape and drive efficient growth.

Our goal is to be the global backbone of commerce. To achieve it, we’re looking for entrepreneurial, innovative and determined teammates who are eager to help our growing base of customers simplify their commerce operations and seamlessly reach their own customers, wherever they are. Sound like you? We’d love to hear from you.

Cart.com Fast Facts:

  • 6,000+ customers worldwide
  • 1,600+ employees globally
  • 17 warehouses nationwide, totaling over 10 million square feet of space
  • Headquartered in Houston, TX with international offices in Mexico and Poland

Our values:

Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

  • Be brand obsessed: Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
  • Think beyond the box: “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.
  • Don’t give up: We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
  • Speak up: We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
  • Work together: We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
  • Remember to be human: We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love.

The Role:  

As the Accounts Payable Manager at Cart.com, you will play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our payment processes. You will lead a dynamic team responsible for managing all aspects of the accounts payable function, including processing invoices, ensuring timely payments, and maintaining strong relationships with vendors. Your ability to drive process improvements, ensure compliance, and provide strategic insights will be essential to the financial health and operational success of the company.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape and optimize our AP processes, working closely with cross-functional teams to support our fast-growing business. You will be a key player in our finance department, overseeing AP month-end close activities and preparing for internal and external audits. Your leadership will be instrumental in building a high-performing AP team that thrives on accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

If you are a detail-oriented, strategic thinker with a passion for process optimization and team leadership, this is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact at a rapidly growing e-commerce company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage the AP Function: Oversee the entire accounts payable process, including invoice processing, payment execution, credit applications, vendor management, and reconciliation of accounts.

  • Lead and Mentor the AP Team: Supervise a team of three to four AP associates, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback to ensure high standards of accuracy and efficiency.

  • Ensure Compliance:Monitor and ensure compliance with company policies, tax regulations, and accounting standards, including W-9 and 1099 reporting.

  • Process Improvement:Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of the AP function, including automation and system enhancements.

  • Vendor Relations: Develop and maintain strong relationships with vendors, resolving any issues related to invoicing, payments, or discrepancies in a timely and professional manner.

  • Month-End Close: Support the monthly financial close process by preparing AP-related reconciliations, accruals, and reports, ensuring all AP transactions are accurately recorded.

  • Data Analysis and Reporting: Prepare and analyze AP reports, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on cash flow, payment cycles, and vendor performance.

  • System Management: Collaborate with IT and finance teams to maintain and improve AP systems (e.g., Bill.com, Microsoft Dynamics), ensuring they meet the needs of the business.

  • Audit Preparation: Prepare for and support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and reports related to the AP function.

  • Training and Documentation: Develop training materials and standard operating procedures for the AP team, ensuring consistency and compliance across the department.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with other departments, including procurement, finance, and operations, to streamline processes and support overall business objectives.

Who You Are:

  • Detail-Oriented and Accurate: You have an exceptional eye for detail and prioritize accuracy in all aspects of your work, ensuring the integrity of financial data.

  • Strong Leader: You possess strong leadership skills with the ability to effectively manage, mentor, and motivate a team, fostering a high-performance culture.

  • Process-Oriented: You are adept at developing and refining processes to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and ensure timely payment processing.

  • Proactive Problem Solver: You anticipate challenges and take the initiative to address issues before they escalate, implementing solutions that enhance overall performance.

  • Excellent Communicator: You communicate clearly and effectively, whether it's collaborating with your team, liaising with vendors, or reporting to senior management.

  • Analytical and Strategic: You think critically and strategically, using data to drive decisions and improvements in the AP process.

  • Highly Organized: You are skilled at managing multiple priorities, maintaining organization in a fast-paced environment, and ensuring deadlines are consistently met.

  • Tech-Savvy: You are comfortable working with various accounting and AP systems, quickly adapting to new technologies and tools.

  • Integrity and Confidentiality: You handle all financial data with the utmost integrity and maintain strict confidentiality.

What You’ve Done:

  • 6+ Years of Accounts Payable Experience: Proven experience in managing AP functions, including vendor management, invoice processing, and payment execution.

  • Supervisory Experience:Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor an AP team, ensuring high performance and adherence to deadlines.

  • Experience in High-Growth Environments: Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth companies, ideally in the e-commerce or technology sector.

  • Strong Knowledge of AP Systems: Proficient in AP tools such as Bill.com, Microsoft Dynamics, and other ERP systems.

  • Advanced Excel Skills:Expertise in Excel, including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and complex data analysis.

  • Process Improvement Mindset: Proven track record of identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

  • Knowledge of Tax Compliance: Familiarity with tax regulations related to AP, including W-9 and 1099 reporting.

  • Experience with Automation Tools: Experience implementing or working with automation tools to streamline AP processes.

  • Project Management Experience: Ability to manage AP-related projects, including system upgrades or process overhauls.

Nice to Haves: 

  • CPA or Relevant Certification: Professional certification such as CPA or CMA is a plus, demonstrating a deep understanding of financial principles.

  • Experience with Multi-Entity Organizations: Experience managing AP for multi-entity or multi-location businesses.

  • Experience with Automation Tools: Experience implementing or working with automation tools to streamline AP processes.

  • Familiarity with International Payments: Experience managing AP processes involving international vendors and currencies.

All hiring is contingent on eligibility to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or transfer visas for applicants.

jobs.description:
R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems, and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration.

As a Senior Analytics Analyst, you will own the reporting and analysis behind R1's front-end revenue cycle - pre-registration, pre-authorization, and insurance verification. This is one of the harder analytics problems in the business: the data doesn't sit in one database, so you'll pull it together from systems, engineers, and the people who run the programs themselves. The numbers you produce go to health system stakeholders and clients as contractual KPIs, which means accuracy here has direct financial consequences. You'll join a team of three analysts, taking over a well-established and genuinely complex book of work.


What you'll do

  • Build and deliver recurring and ad-hoc reporting on pre-service performance for internal leaders and client stakeholders
  • Source data that lives across multiple systems and owners, partnering directly with engineers and pre-service program teams to get what isn't in a database
  • Write intermediate-to-advanced SQL - CTEs, window functions, unions, and the right join for the job - against Databricks and related platforms
  • Develop Power BI dashboards and DAX measures that make front-end KPIs clear to non-technical audiences
  • Automate recurring reporting and manual workflows using Power Automate and Excel
  • Analyze complex datasets to surface trends, patterns, and anomalies, then translate them into concise summaries leadership can act on
  • Validate data transfers and reporting outputs, since these metrics carry contractual obligations
  • Take full ownership of a defined reporting portfolio and the stakeholder relationships that come with it


What we're looking for

  • Intermediate or better SQL, with fluency in CTEs, row-number/window functions, unions, and join logic
  • Hands-on Databricks experience
  • Advanced Excel - XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and the speed that comes from really knowing the tool
  • Power BI, including comfort building with DAX
  • Power Automate
  • Experience working in analytics with complex datasets, ideally in healthcare, finance, or operations
  • Strong communication skills - much of this data is obtained by asking the right people the right questions
  • Preferred: Snowflake, Python, and experience applying AI to real analytics work (Databricks especially)


This role might be right for you if…

  • You'd rather chase down a fragmented data source than wait for someone to hand you a clean table
  • You like being trusted to run your own work and make your own calls
  • You want your reporting to matter - these KPIs are tied to contractual commitments, not just a dashboard someone glances at
  • You're curious about applying AI in day-to-day analytics
  • You enjoy a collaborative team where people genuinely help each other out


Your first 30 and 90 days

  • First 30 days: Learning and access. You'll get provisioned across the various systems this team depends on, meet your stakeholders, and start absorbing the reporting portfolio you're inheriting. Success looks like moving access forward quickly and asking sharp questions.
  • By 90 days: You've taken over the full scope of that portfolio and are running it independently, with your manager available for guidance and decisions rather than day-to-day direction.

jobs.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

ExtraHop is at the forefront of innovation in the cybersecurity space, delivering cutting-edge Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions that empower organizations to detect, respond to, and mitigate cyber risks in real time.

Join ExtraHop as a Software Engineer III and help us build a fault-resilient, highly available, and customer-centric platform. In this role you will work as part of a collaborative engineering team to build a scalable and secure platform and deliver customer-facing AI/ML features that enable security teams to stop threats in their tracks. This is a rewarding opportunity for an engineer who is obsessed with customer success, passionate about building reliable software, and learning new technologies that contribute to AI/ML-powered security capabilities in production systems.

Our services and features are written primarily in Python, with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and type-first design. Our team develops public REST APIs, solves database scalability challenges, implements data migrations, and enables configuration management across our fleet of services. The R(x) 360 Platform is built on AWS and GCP and utilizes Terraform to define Infrastructure-as-Code across our services and high-throughput data pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, and maintain software components that support AI/ML models, agentic processes, and data pipelines.
  • Contribute to the monitoring, evaluation, and improvement of algorithms used in behavioral detectors.
  • Participate in agile development processes, code reviews, and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers, data scientists, and threat researchers to integrate AI/ML features into the broader product architecture.
  • Implement well-scoped features and technical improvements with limited guidance from senior team members.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to engineering standards and best practices.
  • Help identify and address technical debt to continually improve our codebase and technical stack.
  • Stay current on the latest cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies to contribute to product enhancements.
  • Assist in the documentation of product features, technical specifications, and engineering guides.
  • Support a culture of curiosity, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, preferably in backend, cloud, or security related systems.
  • Solid knowledge of Python, with strong general programming fundamentals.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, a self-starter mentality, and the ability to take ownership and deliver well-defined technical tasks.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently with limited guidance in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Desire to grow in the intersection of software engineering, cybersecurity, and AI/Machine Learning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with machine learning, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience with other languages such as Go, or an equivalent programming language.
  • Familiarity with building distributed, highly available cloud based systems, preferably on AWS.
  • Experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure (EKS / RDS / S3 / SQS / EC2 / IAM).
  • Experience with infrastructure as a software tooling, such as HashiCorp (Packer, Vault, Terraform).
  • Experience in API development, PostgreSQL database design, or SQL query performance optimization.
  • Familiarity with machine learning applications in cybersecurity or NDR environments.
  • Knowledge of tools and frameworks commonly used in network detection and response.
  • Understanding of threat detection, intrusion prevention, and incident response strategies.

The salary range for this role is $145,000 - $163,000 + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

About Ancestry:

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.

We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- see the full list of eligible US locations HERE). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.

Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

Ancestry is seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Fellow to join our AI Applied Science Content team. This fellowship is designed for a researcher at the intersection of industry-scale data and academic rigor. In this role, you will lead research at the forefront of Document Understanding, designing and implementing AI-Native agentic systems to unlock insights from billions of historical and genealogical records. Your work will focus on advancing the state of the art in autonomous multi-agent workflows and on transforming unstructured historical records into structured, searchable knowledge that connects customers to their family history.

What you will do:

  • Innovate with State-of-the-Art AI: Implement cutting-edge AI solutions for key Document Understanding tasks such as OCR/HTR, transcription, Named Entity Recognition (NER), Relation Extraction (RE), Coreference Resolution, Summarization, and Knowledge Graphs working with diverse genealogical and historical collections spanning newspapers, city directories, family history books, and vital records (i.e., birth, marriage, & death records).

  • Architect Agentic Systems: Design and implement multi-agent workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, AgentCore, Strands, Google ADK, A2A, etc. to automate complex multi-step reasoning tasks in historical document analysis and information extraction.

  • Analyze and Optimize Multi-Modal Models: Evaluate the performance of multi-modal AI & LLMs such as GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama, and Qwen for zero-shot and few-shot scenarios in comprehensive document understanding.

  • Natural Language Processing (NLP): NER, Relation Extraction, Coreference Resolution, Entity Resolution, Knowledge Graphs (Neo4j), spaCy, NLTK, BERT.

  • Computer Vision (CV): Apply expertise using models like YOLO, Nougat, DONUT, OpenCV, etc. to perform layout analysis, identifying text blocks, headers, tables, and deeply nested lists.

  • Evaluation & Observability: Establish ensemble models and "LLM-as-a-Judge" frameworks, and use tools like Arize Phoenix, DeepEval, or RAGAS to monitor or hallucination, drift, and bias.

  • Development Productivity: Familiarity with "AI coding" workflows and usage of AI coding assistants such as Amazon Q, Cursor, Claude Code, and Kiro to accelerate development cycles.

  • Collaborate on Cloud Deployment: Partner with ML Ops to deploy datasets, models, and pipelines in cloud environments like AWS (S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, ECS, EKS) and GCP (Vertex AI, Gemini API).

Who You Are:

  • Ph.D. (recent graduate or near completion) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Linguistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field with a strong research focus.

  • A strong record of academic publications in NLP, CV, or Agentic AI is preferred.

  • Specialization in AI & LLMs, including familiarity with foundational models such as GPT, Gemini, Qwen, Llama, Claude, etc.

  • Research in inference efficiency and optimization, potentially using vLLM, LoRA, QLoRA, and quantization approaches.

  • Familiar with embeddings, vector databases, and transformer models, with software development experience.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and relevant tools and libraries, including transformer models and multi-modal models.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and related AI/ML services such as Google Cloud

  • Platform, GCP, Gemini API, Vertex AI, AWS EC2, S3, SageMaker, Model Registry, and Bedrock are a plus.

  • Ability to clearly present complex technical solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Job Title: Sr. Manager, Analytics & BI Engineering

Reports to: Director, Data Platforms & Engineering

Location: US (Remote)

Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts,

Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington


The Role

As the Sr. Manager, Analytics & BI Engineering, you will own the engineering capability for governed metrics and reporting delivery at Deckers. You’ll lead the implementation of enterprise metric definitions in the semantic layer, certify and enforce them, and ensure consistency across all reporting assets. This role is pivotal in building trust in our data, empowering business decisions, and developing analytics capability across the organization. You’ll direct both internal analytics engineering staff and an external BI delivery bench, setting standards, reusable patterns, and quality controls that drive reliable, impactful reporting.


We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.


Your Impact

  • Own the semantic layer as the engineered source of enterprise metric definitions, including model design, technical certification, and consistent enforcement across every reporting asset.
  • Implement metric definitions set by data governance and data product functions, providing engineering input to resolve conflicting definitions across brands and business functions.
  • Own metric and report level quality, including reconciliation to the source of truth, definition consistency, and certification criteria for reporting assets.
  • Own the correctness, performance, and maintainability of reporting assets produced across data product teams, from certified data products through to production reporting.
  • Define and enforce engineering standards for metrics and reporting, covering model design, calculation logic, visual design, documentation, testing, source control, and release practices.
  • Own workspace structure, content organization, dataset certification and promotion, and the access and security model for the reporting platform.
  • Manage and mentor analytics engineers, BI developers, and analysts through coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Establish metrics engineering as a defined craft within the organization, with its own standards, skills development, and career path.
  • Build the delivery model and intake process for metrics and reporting work, translating business needs into prioritized and sequenced delivery.
  • Lead the analytics function within the pillar, serving business areas with analysis and reporting built on certified metrics.
  • Build analytics capability inside business functions, defining maturity criteria and transition paths for moving analytics ownership closer to the business.
  • Direct the external business intelligence delivery bench, including capacity planning, work allocation, quality review, and partner performance management.
  • Supply metrics and reporting engineering capability into cross-functional data product teams, building durable domain knowledge.
  • Build and maintain reusable semantic models and reporting delivery patterns for consistent, performant, and repeatable output.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 8–12 years of experience building enterprise metrics, reporting, and business intelligence solutions.
  • 3–5+ years leading analytics engineering, BI engineering, or reporting teams.
  • Hands-on experience owning an enterprise reporting platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Qlik, including content governance, dataset certification, row-level security, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with semantic layer or OLAP modeling technology such as AtScale, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML, or Analysis Services.
  • Experience directing external delivery partners or contractor benches, including capacity planning, work allocation, and quality management.
  • Experience leading an analytics or insights team that serves business functions directly, including translating ambiguous business questions into defined, testable metrics.
  • Experience building analytics capability within business functions and transitioning ownership is preferred.
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms, preferably AWS, and with dbt-modeled data.
  • Deep expertise in dimensional modeling, semantic modeling, and metric definition, including SQL and a BI calculation language such as DAX or MDX.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise BI platform architecture, content governance, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to create reusable patterns and standards that scale delivery across internal and partner teams.
  • Strong delivery partner and contractor management skills, including capacity planning and quality control.
  • Strong leadership and people-management skills, with a focus on coaching and developing talent.
  • Ability to operate within a governance model owned by others while holding a firm line on engineering standards.
  • Ability to drive technical excellence while balancing speed, quality, and operational stability.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills across technical and business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed, and global environment.

What We'll Give You –

  • Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
  • Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
  • Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.

  • Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
  • Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.

Meet Instinct 👋

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

A Sneak Peek of Your Role 🔭

This is a fully remote role.

Instinct Science builds an ecosystem of AI-powered and clinical software products used across veterinary medicine: ScribbleVet (AI documentation), Instinct EMR, Instinct Treatment Plans, Standards of Care, and Plumb's. We're hiring a Sales Development Manager to own our outbound engine end to end.

This is an execution role. You'll hire, ramp, and develop a team of BDRs. You'll own the strategy and playbook that makes them productive and be accountable to the pipeline that comes out the other side. No rev ops background required. You need to be a doer: someone who coaches to behavior change and drives a team to predictable output.

You'll report directly to the Director of Sales and will be the primary owner of pipeline generation through outbound, leading a team of two BDRs and one SDR to start.

At 9 months: your team is ramped, performing, and developing. Pipeline is predictable. Reps know exactly where they're going.

What You'll Do 🛠️

  • Build and maintain a high-performing team that consistently hits pipeline targets. Own the hiring bar, the 90-day ramp, and individual performance accountability
  • Drive predictable pipeline through a structured weekly coaching cadence; inspect behavior and root-cause misses before they become missed quarters
  • Evaluate and optimize the outbound playbook across ICP targeting, messaging, sequence strategy, and the prospecting tech stack. Know what to keep, what to cut, and what to rebuild
  • Get into the work with your reps: join calls, run live coaching sessions, and lead from the front a couple times per week
  • Build individual development plans for each rep with a defined path toward AE or team leadership. Hold yourself accountable to those promotions happening
  • Partner with Marketing and Sales to align on ICP evolution, campaign activation, and pipeline handoffs. Hold that alignment to outcomes, not just intent
  • Own and optimize the outbound tech stack: CRM and pipeline hygiene in HubSpot, high-velocity dialing in Nooks, and call coaching in Airspeed
  • Run the team's operating rhythm: standups, 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and SPIFFs. Build a culture of consistency and accountability

Who You Are 🐱‍💻

Must Haves:

  • 2 to 4 years leading a BDR or SDR team at a SaaS or technology company, with documented attainment against team targets
  • A repeatable hiring process for BDRs; you know what an A-player looks like on screen and can evaluate for it consistently
  • Demonstrated ability to coach rep behavior and change output, not just report on it
  • Data fluency: you pull your own reports, read pipeline signals before they become problems, and coach to leading indicators
  • Working knowledge of contact and account data quality: what good looks like, where it breaks down, and how to partner with RevOps to drive continuous improvement. You won't own the infrastructure but you'll push it forward
  • Comfort evaluating and optimizing an existing motion. You know what to keep, what to cut, and what to rebuild. You do it without disrupting what's working
  • Experience holding cross-functional alignment with Marketing and Sales to pipeline outcomes, not just pipeline intent
  • Excellent written and verbal communication

Preferred:

  • Experience selling into veterinary, healthcare, or clinical buyer personas
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Nooks, or similar outbound tech stacks
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted outbound workflows
  • SaaS background, ideally vertical SaaS or SMB/mid-market

How Instinct will Care about YOU 🌞

  • We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
  • We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
  • We pay our team well.
  • We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
  • We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
  • We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
  • We provide all-expense-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.

The compensation range for this role is $110,000 - $155,000. This range reflects a mix of base salary and variable compensation earned through performance, and actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

jobs.excerpt: About JunoJuno leverages collective bargaining power to secure better student loan rates for higher education students.
jobs.description:
About Juno

Juno leverages collective bargaining power to secure better student loan rates for higher education students. With 290,000+ members and over $2B in negotiated loan volume, we've proven that group buying works. We are the most popular way to pay for the world's top graduate programs, and we stay with our members after graduation to help them refinance at lower rates.

The Problem

Federal lending reforms have created a significant market shift. In July 2026, new caps on federal graduate loans, including the elimination of Grad PLUS for new students, came into effect, leaving millions of students with significant funding gaps. Students who fill that gap with private loans will enter repayment looking to lower their rates. Borrowers need transparent, competitive options both in school and after graduation.

Your Mission

Juno serves members across the life of their loans, from paying for school to refinancing after graduation. You'll work directly with a member of Juno's executive team to decide where we invest our time and capital along that path. That means deciding which schools, partners, and lenders to prioritize, and which initiatives to scale or wind down. You'll build the analysis, work with the relevant business unit leaders on a plan, and drive it through execution.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate performance. Assess the historical results of our partners, events, and initiatives, from first touch through funded in-school and refinance loans.
  • Set priorities. Build the ROI case for new initiatives and decide which schools, partners, and segments to prioritize each season.
  • Connect school to refinance. Identify distribution channels with access to borrowers looking to refinance and build a plan to capture these opportunities.
  • Expand the lender marketplace. Lead diligence and onboarding for new lenders across both in-school loans and refinance.
  • Run the operating cadence. Set milestones and metrics with each business unit and track every initiative through to results.
  • Lead where needed. Step into key business roles as needs arise, taking hands-on ownership of a team or function to fill leadership gaps, launch new initiatives, or accelerate growth.

What We Offer

Compensation: $120k to $140k, plus variable compensation tied to performance.
Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and retirement matching.

What We're Looking For

  • Background: 2 to 5 years in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or a strategy role at a high-growth company.
  • Analytical rigor. You turn complex data into clear recommendations, using SQL and financial modeling to build the analysis yourself.
  • Commercial judgment. You distinguish activity from impact and will recommend scaling what works and winding down what doesn't.
  • Execution. You carry initiatives from analysis through implementation and keep cross-functional teams aligned on owners and deadlines.
  • Technical leverage. When the tool you need doesn't exist, you build it with AI tooling and APIs.

The X-Factor

  • You're candid: you bring leadership difficult conclusions along with the data behind them.
  • You're persuasive: you can align partners, lenders, and business unit leaders around a single plan.

Interview process

Intro chat with the hiring manager, a case study exercise, cross-functional conversations with senior leadership, and references.

Why Join Juno?

Real Impact: Help hundreds of thousands of students and graduates access lower rates
Market Timing: Federal aid changes create massive tailwind for growth
Proven Model: $2B+ negotiated, 290K+ members, product-market fit achieved

We use AI-assisted tools to help screen and review applications in an initial assessment of skills and qualifications against our job requirements. While automation assists our recruitment team in processing high volumes of applications, final decisions on interviews and hiring are always made by human reviewers.

Din rolle som dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejder
Bliv ansigtet udadtil for vores klient – en international virksomhed i modebranchen, hvor kvalitet og kundeoplevelse er i centrum. I denne rolle vil du:

  • Du har nemt ved at tilegne dig ny information og omstiller dig hurtigt til nye forudsætninger.

  • En positiv indstilling og en passion for at levere en førsteklasses kundeoplevelse – du mener, at kunden fortjener mere end bare support.

For at arbejde hjemmefra skal du have:

  • Stabil internetforbindelse på mindst 10 Mbit/s (fiber/kabel).

  • Et roligt og egnet arbejdsmiljø i hjemmet.

  • Bopæl i Sverige: Tjenesten kræver, at du er bosat i Sverige.

Om Transcom
Transcom er en global specialist inden for kundeservice og kundetilfredshed gennem vores omfattende netværk af 90 kontaktcentre i 29 lande på 33 sprog. Vi er innovative og har en passion for at løse problemer. Desuden er vi en af Sveriges største arbejdsgivere for unge mennesker. Hos Transcom er vi engagerede – i vores kunder og i hinanden. Hver dag starter nogen sin rejse hos Transcom. Vi tager det potentiale, du har i dag, og omdanner det til kompetencer for fremtiden. Her bliver du anerkendt for dit hårde arbejde, for at være en holdspiller og for at støtte andre. Vi bidrager til positive forandringer i vores teams og samfundet. Det er præcis sådan, vi er hos Transcom. Her tager vi os af hinanden. Du er inkluderet, præcis som du er, fra dag ét. Med den rette indstilling er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt vi kan nå sammen.

Vi er en arbejdsplads med lige vilkår, og alle kvalificerede kandidater vil blive taget i betragtning uden hensyn til race, hudfarve, religion, køn, national oprindelse, handicap eller andre egenskaber beskyttet af loven.
