  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Own the entire accounting function of a fast-growing premium food brand with major retail and DTC distribution
  • Real room to grow as the company scales, up to running the whole system independently

What You'll Work On

Full-Cycle Accounting and Monthly Close

  • Run the monthly, quarterly, and annual close on a proactive, tight calendar with no chasing and no surprises
  • Own AP, AR, bank and credit card reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, and intercompany entries
  • Keep an accurate, reconciled balance sheet and a clear, timely income statement with variance commentary management can act on
  • Work with the outside firm to internalize their work and steadily take full ownership

CPG Inventory Reconciliation

  • Reconcile inventory across finished goods, raw materials, and packaging across multiple locations and channels
  • Track inventory movements from purchase through production, warehousing, and sale and ensure every movement is accurately reflected in the books
  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies between the ledger, warehouse records, and third-party systems
  • Build and maintain inventory reporting that gives management real-time visibility into stock levels, valuation, and COGS

Revenue Recognition and Financial Statements

  • Apply US GAAP revenue recognition for CPG and FMCG including gross-to-net, trade spend, slotting, promotions, and returns so the top line is clean and defensible
  • Keep the books audit-ready and lender-ready at all times, backed by a clean audit trail that stands up to bank and lender scrutiny
  • Own audit prep and support external auditors and tax preparers

Deductions and Chargebacks

  • Own retail and distributor deductions and chargebacks end to end including shortages, MCBs, spoilage, and freight
  • Identify, document, validate, and dispute deductions, file at scale, track recovery, and lead the workflow that wins back cash that would otherwise be lost
  • Reach out to customers and distributors on AR, collections, and disputed deductions to resolve issues early and keep cash coming in

Cost Analysis and Savings

  • Analyze margin, COGS, vendor spend, and freight to find cost leaks and bring management specific, actionable ways to save without being asked
  • Manage cash reporting, AR aging, vendor terms, and inputs to forecasting and the line of credit

Compliance

  • Own sales tax, 1099s, and internal controls and keep the company diligence-ready as it raises capital

Dashboard Building and AI-First Ways of Working

  • Build and maintain live dashboards and trackers for close status, AR aging, inventory position, deductions and recovery, cash, and margin — the team should see the numbers without asking
  • Design dashboards that are actionable, not just informational, and update them as the business evolves
  • Own and run the cloud finance stack including Xero and Airtable with disciplined, well-documented books
  • Connect and automate across the ledger, banks, Airtable, deduction management, OCR, and settlement tools so data flows without manual re-keying
  • Use Claude daily to reconcile, categorize, draft dispute packages, speed up analysis, and build repeatable documented processes around it — always check the AI's work before it reaches the books

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field
  • At least 5 years of full-cycle accounting including running a monthly close and preparing financial statements
  • CPG inventory reconciliation experience is a hard requirement — you must understand how inventory moves through a food or consumer goods brand and how to reconcile it accurately across locations and channels
  • Proven ability to build dashboards that give management live visibility into financial and operational performance
  • Strong Claude AI proficiency — you use it daily, you know its limits, and you sanity-check its output before it reaches the books
  • Working command of US GAAP with experience supporting US-based companies
  • Comfortable owning and running a stack like Xero and Airtable, not just working inside it
  • Exposure to trade spend, deductions, and distributor or retailer chargeback disputes
  • Excellent written and spoken English with proactive communication across time zones
  • Flags issues early and closes loops without being asked
  • CPG, FMCG, food and beverage, or consumer goods experience strongly preferred

Nice to Have

  • CPA or local equivalent
  • Experience with natural channel distributors such as UNFI or KeHE
  • Background supporting a high-growth or venture-backed consumer brand
  • Prior experience bringing accounting in house from an outside firm
  • Experience building automated accounting workflows beyond dashboards including OCR, settlement reconciliation, or deduction management tooling

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your CPG inventory reconciliation experience, walking through a dashboard you built and what it enabled, and explaining how you use Claude in your daily accounting workflow

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a sharp, full-cycle accountant who can own the books end to end, reconcile CPG inventory accurately, build dashboards that actually get used, and use Claude every day to run a finance function that punches above its weight, this role gives you the ownership and the room to grow to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

jobs.description:
About the role

We're a global education company running live, expert-led business courses across multiple markets. As we grow, so does the volume of legal questions that come with operating in many jurisdictions at once — how we contract with instructors in different countries, how we structure entities, how we respond when a regulator asks a question.

We're hiring a dedicated legal role to take ownership of the research, analysis, and drafting that sits underneath those decisions.

This is a genuinely broad role for someone early in their legal career who wants exposure to real cross-border commercial and employment questions, rather than a narrow slice of one. You'll research law in jurisdictions you haven't worked in before — the US, the UK and EU, South Africa, Australia, and across APAC — and your job will be to bring back a clear answer, not a hedge.

What you'll do

  • Research legal questions across multiple jurisdictions as we expand — contractor and partner engagement models, entity structuring, employment and commercial law, etc.
  • Draft and maintain our contract templates: consulting agreements, teaching assistant agreements, statements of work, amendments, and termination agreements, with jurisdiction-specific variants
  • Redline counterparty contracts and flag the terms that actually matter
  • Build and own our legal register: active matters, deadlines, obligations, renewals, filings
  • Scope and brief external counsel — write the question, assemble the pack, track cost and turnaround, and pressure-test what comes back
  • Support entity formation, restructuring, and market-entry diligence
  • Maintain approved communication templates and FAQs for teams who work with our instructors
  • Build the systems that let a small legal function support a fast-growing company

Requirements

  • A law degree and 2–4 years of practical legal experience — private practice, in-house, or legal services
  • Excellent written English. The core output of this role is a one-page memo a non-lawyer can act on immediately. Clarity beats comprehensiveness.
  • Proven legal research skill, including in legal systems that aren't your own — and the judgment to know when a question needs local counsel and how to frame it for them
  • Contract drafting and redlining experience
  • Thoughtful, verified use of AI research tools. We use them; we also check every citation at source.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the initiative to turn a half-formed business question into a precise legal one
  • Interest in how the business actually works, not just the legal question in isolation

Nice to have

  • Experience with cross-border contractor or freelancer engagement models
  • Employment or labour law background
  • Admission to the bar in your home jurisdiction
  • Data protection experience (GDPR, POPIA)
  • Experience in a distributed, remote-first company

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation:Competitive salary,Opportunities for career advancement as ELVTR continues to grow globally
  • Learn and Grow:Free access to ELVTR courses,Ongoing professional development opportunities,Career growth within one of the world's fastest-growing online education companies
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from wherever you're most productive, Flexible and supportive work environment,Collaborative international team
  • Health & Wellbeing:Gym membership reimbursement,Mental health support, Generous paid vacation allowance

Why Join ELVTR?

  • Make an Impact:Every course you help create empowers professionals to build new skills, advance their careers, and unlock opportunities they never thought possible.
  • Grow Your Career:We're committed to developing our people. As ELVTR continues to expand globally, you'll have opportunities to grow professionally, take on new challenges, and shape the future of online education.
  • Join a Winning Team:Work alongside passionate educators, creators, marketers, and innovators who are committed to delivering world-class learning experiences and making education more accessible around the world.

Ready to Help Shape the Future of Online Learning?

Submit your CV and a short note on a legal question you researched where the answer wasn't obvious — what you found, and what you recommended.

jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor de verdere uitbouw en professionalisering van een Microsoft Fabric-dataplatform wordt een senior data architect gezocht, die deels ook als solution architect optreedt. De opdracht focust op het uitwerken van een toekomstbestendige visie op data-architectuur, governance en operationeel beheer, en op het begeleiden van strategische, architecturale en technische keuzes.

  • Meewerken aan de verdere opbouw, vervollediging en verbetering van het dataplatform.
  • Vertalen van conceptuele informatiemodellen naar logische datamodellen.
  • Uitwerken van een datastrategie en data-architectuur voor een duurzame, schaalbare en beheersbare oplossing.
  • Definiëren en toepassen van standaarden rond dataopslag, datamodellering, data-integratie, analytics, security, deployment en operationeel beheer.
  • Ondersteunen bij de uitbouw van governance rond onder meer eigenaarschap van data, rollen en verantwoordelijkheden, toegangsbeheer, datakwaliteit, metadatabeheer en levenscyclusbeheer van dataproducten.
  • Begeleiden van de inrichting van een veilige en efficiënte self-service dataomgeving binnen Microsoft Fabric en Power BI.
  • Adviseren over werkruimtes, semantische modellen, rapporten, apps, publicatieprocessen en gecontroleerde samenwerking tussen verschillende gebruikersgroepen.
  • Samenwerken met betrokken business- en ICT-medewerkers, ICT-architectuur en operations om de juiste invulling aan de opdracht te geven.
  • Afstemmen van keuzes en beslissingen met de betrokken medewerkers en stakeholders via overleg, projectgroepen en stuurgroepen.
  • Coachen van interne medewerkers, kennis delen via terugkoppelsessies en bijdragen aan kennisoverdracht zodat het interne team implementaties maximaal zelfstandig kan uitvoeren en beheren.
  • Waar nodig actief bijdragen aan concrete end-to-end implementaties binnen één of meerdere datadomeinen.
  • Proactief advies formuleren rond verbeteringen die bijdragen aan de verdere maturiteit van het dataplatform.

Het beoogde resultaat is een duurzaam en beheersbaar dataplatform met uitgewerkte architectuurprincipes, governance-richtlijnen, operationele standaarden en één of meerdere geïmplementeerde datadomeinen volgens deze principes.

📌 Context

Er wordt gewerkt aan een robuust en gestandaardiseerd dataplatform op basis van Microsoft Fabric op Azure. Een eerste traject resulteerde in een initiële Fabric-omgeving, de migratie van data van een on-premise SQL Server naar de cloud en een eerste rapporteringsoplossing in Power BI. De volgende fase richt zich op verdere professionalisering, standaardisering en governance, met bijzondere aandacht voor architectuurvisie, best practices en beheersbaarheid.

Een belangrijke pijler binnen deze ontwikkeling is het self-service principe, waarbij businessgebruikers, analisten en data engineers op een gecontroleerde en veilige manier toegang krijgen tot data en analytische mogelijkheden. Dit vereist een doordachte inrichting van Microsoft Fabric, met aandacht voor datagovernance, toegangsbeheer, metadata- en datacatalogisering, werkruimtebeheer en monitoring.

Technologische context van het dataplatform en de bredere omgeving omvat onder meer Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure DevOps, MS SQL Server, Python, SQL en Spark. Daarnaast is er een bredere ontwikkel- en productieomgeving met onder meer .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, Entity Framework Core, Dapper, RabbitMQ, IIS, REST, GraphQL, Azure Monitor, SonarQube en ArcGIS Server.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Aantoonbare ervaring als data architect in meerdere projecten met complexe data-architectuurproblematiek.
  • Ervaring met het opzetten en uitwerken van datastrategie en data-architectuur.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in het vertalen van conceptuele informatiemodellen naar logische datamodellen.
  • Ervaring met datastandaarden en data management.
  • Ervaring met programmeertalen en scriptingtalen.
  • Senior ervaring met MS Azure DevOps.
  • Ervaring met MS Fabric.
  • Senior ervaring met Power BI.
  • Ervaring binnen de publieke of overheidssector is een meerwaarde.
  • Algemene kennis van of ervaring met wetgeving en procedures binnen landbouw en mestbeleid is een pluspunt.
  • Nederlandstalig op Europees CEFR-niveau C2.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. jobs.description:
About Wellspring

Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs. Founded in 2003, Wellspring has grown to serve over 500 organizations globally, including Fortune 500 companies, SMEs, hospitals, and universities. The company’s flagship products—Evolve, Astria, Sophia & Flintbox—enable organizations to manage the entire innovation lifecycle, from discovery and IP management to commercialization and knowledge transfer.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are hiring a Quality Engineer to help shape how quality is engineered in an AI-driven development environment. Quality Engineers at Wellspring operate with a high degree of autonomy and technical ownership, with meaningful cross-team influence. This role is ideal for an engineer who wants to remain hands-on, technically deep, and influential in shaping modern, AI-driven quality practices.

What You'll Do

Automated Quality Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites using Playwright
  • Develop and maintain performance and load tests using JMeter
  • Create reusable test utilities, data strategies, and scalable testing patterns
  • Build and curate the shared foundation that AI-assisted authoring depends on so generated tests come out consistent
  • Keep the suite healthy as authoring volume increases

AI-Driven Quality Practices

  • Use AI-assisted tools to generate, refine, and maintain test cases, and test data
  • Direct coding agents through the full authoring loop providing context and reviewing output
  • Review generated tests with a critical eye for the ways they fail quietly
  • Use AI to find coverage gaps and propose edge cases, then apply your own judgment about which ones carry real risk
  • Use AI-assisted triage as a first pass on failures, separating likely regressions from flakes
  • Apply self-healing and auto-repair tooling deliberately, with guardrails, recognizing that a test which silently repairs itself can mask a genuine product regression
  • Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical and defect-prone areas
  • Validate AI-enabled product behavior for correctness, reliability, and unintended outcomes
  • Feed recurring defect and failure patterns back into shared context and conventions so the same class of miss does not recur

CI/CD & Engineering Integration

  • Integrate automated tests into GitHub Actions–based CI/CD pipelines
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to improve pipeline quality gates
  • Manage test scope and execution sequencing to balance coverage, risk, and feedback time
  • Write tests and failure output that are legible to agents as well as engineers
  • Ensure quality gates hold as change volume increases, so higher delivery throughput does not quietly become higher-confidence mistakes

Quality Leadership & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Architecture to clarify requirements and identify quality risks early
  • Propose and drive solutions to technical and testing challenges with cross-functional partners
  • Help establish team standards for AI-driven test authoring
  • Document and communicate testing strategies, tradeoffs, and outcomes

What We're Looking For

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience as a Quality Engineer, SDET, or Test Automation Engineer on production systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright (UI and API testing)
  • Experience with performance and load testing using JMeter or similar tools
  • Solid programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Java, or Python
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions
  • Working knowledge of modern architectures, including web applications, APIs, and cloud-based systems
  • Demonstrated, sustained daily use of at least one modern AI-assisted development tool
  • Ability to critically review AI-generated tests and code — identifying shallow coverage, incorrect assumptions, and plausible-looking output that does not hold up

Ways You'll Stand Out

  • Experience testing AI-enabled or data-driven systems
  • Experience designing automation frameworks or shared testing infrastructure
  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, or quality metrics beyond pass/fail testing
  • Experience building evaluation harnesses or test strategies for non-deterministic systems

Description

We’re looking for a motivated Junior Developer to help us build reliable, modern software solutions as part of our growing engineering team.

Do you enjoy learning new technologies, writing clean code, and improving a little every day? Are you excited about turning ideas into working features? We're looking for someone who can collaborate closely with teammates, follow established development practices, and help build solid, maintainable applications.

This is a hands-on development role where you’ll focus on implementing well-defined features, learning best practices, and growing your technical foundation. You’ll work within an established architecture, supported by experienced engineers who will guide you through design decisions, patterns, and development processes.

You’ll contribute across the stack—building APIs, developing UI components, working with databases, and delivering features that teams and customers rely on.

What Will You Be Doing?

Application Development

You will:

  • Develop features using .NET (C#) and ASP.NET Core
  • Build and extend REST APIs
  • Create UI components using Angular or React
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend services
  • Apply foundational understanding of:
    • HTTP protocol
    • Request/response lifecycle
    • Status codes
    • Basic API design principles

Your focus will be on implementing features in accordance with clear technical guidelines.

Code Quality & Design Principles

You should demonstrate:

  • Understanding of SOLID principles
  • Familiarity with Clean Code practices
  • Knowledge of common GoF design patterns
  • Understanding of layered architecture (Controller → Service → Repository)

You’ll apply these concepts under the guidance of senior engineers.

Microservices & Cloud Awareness

You will need a conceptual understanding of:

  • What microservices are
  • Basic cloud concepts (Azure / AWS)
  • Cloud storage (Blob / S3)
  • Environment separation (Dev, QA, Prod)

Your role is to work within the existing architecture—not define it.

Data & Persistence

You will:

  • Work with relational databases (MS SQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Understand relationships and normalization basics
  • Use Entity Framework for CRUD operations
  • Understand basic indexing concepts
  • Be aware of NoSQL systems (Cosmos DB conceptually)

You’ll extend existing models rather than design full database strategies.

Security & API Fundamentals

You should understand:

  • Authentication vs. authorization
  • JWT basics
  • Role-based access control
  • Basic REST security practices

You’ll implement defined security flows and patterns.

Tools & Development Process

You are expected to:

  • Use Git effectively (branching, merging, pull requests)
  • Follow the team’s branching strategy
  • Use debugging tools
  • Implement logging and error handling
  • Participate fully in Scrum ceremonies
  • Deliver tasks within sprint commitments

Who You Are (Non-Technical Skills)

Ownership (Task-Level)

  • Take responsibility for assigned work
  • Communicate blockers early
  • Deliver within the agreed scope

Learning Mindset

  • Eager to learn and grow
  • Accept and apply feedback
  • Show initiative with new tools and technologies

Communication

  • Communicate clearly within the team
  • Collaborate respectfully
  • Participate actively in team processes

Who we are

Init is a group of software and automation companies offering sustainable, innovative, and long-term solutions to various Nordic and worldwide industries. Init was established in January 2022 by 17 companies joining forces. Today, it has over 900 highly qualified employees in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, North Macedonia, UK and Spain.

jobs.excerpt: Mission-Driven.  Honor-Bound.  Fairbanks Morse Defense.
jobs.description:
Mission-Driven. Honor-Bound. Fairbanks Morse Defense. What’s your calling? For the men and women of Fairbanks Morse Defense it’s the rapid and effective support of the fleets that entrust us to design, develop, and deliver the best naval power technology on the planet. We’re one of the nation’s leading marine defense contractors because of the highly trained and dedicated teams that provide reliable power systems, parts, and aftermarket services to the U.S. Navy, Coast Guard, Military Sealift Command, and Canadian Coast Guard. When you join Fairbanks Morse Defense, you join a legacy of commitment that spans 150 years. Fairbanks Morse Defense offers competitive benefits with a wide range of training and development opportunities. Our world-class teams are dedicated to helping every individual achieve their full potential. Discover what it’s like to be a part of the Fairbanks Morse Defense team here:

Summary Fairbanks Morse Defense builds and supports the engines and power systems that keep U.S. Navy and Coast Guard ships underway. Our Aftermarket business is launching a portfolio of AI, business intelligence, and process-automation projects under the Fairbanks Morse Operating System (FMOS) continuous improvement program, with one goal: help our people quote faster, serve customers better, and spend less time on manual data work. We are hiring an Applied AI Engineer to be the hands-on builder behind that portfolio. The idea pipeline is already prioritized and the program has active executive sponsorship. What we need is the engineer who turns those ideas into secure, production-grade AI solutions running in Microsoft Azure: an inside-sales assistant that answers questions from our technical manuals, an agent that reviews contracts and drafts quotes, automated pricing and PO checks, onboarding assistants for new hires, and more. This is a fully remote role. No security clearance is required. Why This Role

  • Greenfield work with real users. You will design and ship from a prioritized backlog, not maintain someone else’s legacy system, and see your work used by sales, service, and engineering teams.
  • Modern tools, encouraged. We expect you to build with AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Codex, and to help set the standard for using them securely.
  • Visible impact. You will work directly with executive sponsors and business leaders, and your results will be measured in hours saved, faster quotes, and better customer service.
  • A mission that matters. Your solutions help keep U.S. naval vessels ready and supported.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • AI Solution Development & Deployment

◦ Partner with the continuous improvement lead, executive sponsors, and business subject-matter experts to turn prioritized ideas into deployed, measurable solutions, starting with the highest-impact, lowest-effort items. ◦ Design, build, and deploy AI agents using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use / function calling, and human-in-the-loop controls for use cases such as a technical-data inside-sales assistant, contract review and quoting, project-brief and after-action-review generation, and new-hire onboarding. ◦ Build document-processing and OCR workflows over technical manuals, contracts, Excel workbooks, and scanned content. ◦ Develop process-automation solutions, such as EDI-style order processing, PO review and compliance checks, price justification, and “like-parts” categorization, that remove manual effort and improve accuracy. ◦ Use AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development and help establish best practices for their secure use across the team.

  • Azure & Platform

◦ Deploy and operate solutions in Microsoft Azure, including App Service / Functions, storage, identity, and Azure OpenAI, within a government-cloud (GCC-High) tenant. ◦ Work with the IT team to connect solutions to existing systems through virtual networks, private endpoints, and secure APIs. ◦ Set up CI/CD pipelines, logging, and monitoring so solutions are repeatable, observable, and reliable in production. ◦ Handle credentials, model inputs/outputs, and sensitive data securely, in line with the company’s government-contract compliance requirements.

  • Integration & Data

◦ Integrate with enterprise systems such as Oracle ERP, Salesforce, Oracle Hyperion Financial Management (HFM), and CPQ / quoting tools; build and secure the REST APIs and data pipelines that feed AI solutions. ◦ Support reporting and dashboard needs (e.g., revenue/margin, P&L, and utilization) where they complement AI and automation projects.

  • Technical Leadership

◦ Serve as the technical lead for AI and automation projects: help define requirements with subject-matter experts and coordinate with FMD’s technology development and AI team and with IT. ◦ Establish development standards, documentation, and evaluation / observability practices to measure and continuously improve AI output quality. ◦ Help track solution impact and ROI so the program can demonstrate value early. ◦ Provide technical direction to other developers and contract resources supporting the initiative.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years building and supporting production software, automation, or AI solutions, with a BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating applications in Microsoft Azure (e.g., App Service / Functions, storage, identity, and Azure OpenAI / Azure AI services).
  • Demonstrated experience shipping LLM-based applications to production, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use / function calling, and orchestration.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, plus REST API design and integration using modern authentication (OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect).
  • Working experience with Git, CI/CD, and containerization (e.g., Docker), and with AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude / Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, or GitHub Copilot.
  • U.S. citizenship. This position requires access to Unclassified Naval Nuclear Propulsion Information, which is Not Releasable to Foreign Nationals (NOFORN). Candidates must provide proof of U.S. citizenship (U.S. passport, U.S. birth certificate, or naturalization certificate) and attest that they do not hold dual citizenship. No security clearance is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building applications in Azure Government Cloud (GCC-High, FedRAMP, IL4 / IL5) environments.
  • Experience with CMMC and government-contract IT compliance, including NIST 800-171, DFARS, STIG, and RMF.
  • Network design and integration experience, including virtual networks, VPN / private endpoints, and secure connectivity.
  • Experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen, and with vector databases, embedding models, and RAG over large technical-document collections.
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation, observability, and prompt-engineering best practices.
  • Experience with EDI or order-processing automation, and with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  • Experience building BI dashboards and data models (e.g., Power BI) from ERP and CRM systems such as Oracle and Salesforce.
  • Experience integrating with Oracle ERP, Salesforce, HFM, and CPQ / quoting platforms.
  • JavaScript / TypeScript experience; C# / .NET is a plus.
  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep) and CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Product ownership experience, such as managing a backlog, defining requirements, and tracking ROI.
  • Experience in manufacturing, defense, or maritime / aftermarket service environments, and familiarity with Lean / Six Sigma or other continuous-improvement methods.

This specification is intended to indicate the kinds of tasks and levels of work difficulty that will be required of positions that will be given this title and shall not be construed as declaring what the specific duties and responsibilities of any particular position shall be. It is not intended to limit or in any way modify the right of any supervisor to assign, direct, and control the work of employees under his/her supervision. Ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrated commitment to effective customer service delivery, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Fairbanks Morse Defense.

Fairbanks Morse Defense offers a competitive benefits package including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurances, and 401k retirement plan with employer match. In addition, we offer paid time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, and tuition reimbursement.

The ideal candidate is a highly skilled identity management professional with deep expertise in SailPoint architecture, configuration, and deployment, committed to delivering secure and compliant identity governance solutions in complex federal environments. This position requires an active Secret Clearance. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement. The SailPoint SME will serve as the primary technical expert responsible for the design, implementation, integration, and ongoing management of SailPoint Identity Governance solutions in support of federal government customers. This individual will work closely with security teams, application owners, system administrators, and government stakeholders to ensure SailPoint deployments are secure, scalable, and aligned with federal ICAM standards and identity governance best practices. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Serve as the primary technical subject matter expert for SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow, providing expert-level guidance on architecture, design, and implementation decisions.
  • Lead the design, configuration, and deployment of SailPoint identity governance solutions including access certifications, role management, access request, and provisioning workflows.
  • Perform day-to-day administration and maintenance of the SailPoint platform, including connector configurations, application onboarding, and policy management.
  • Develop and maintain SailPoint connectors, rules, workflows, and custom integrations to support enterprise identity governance requirements.
  • Integrate SailPoint with enterprise applications, directory services, and cloud platforms to enable automated provisioning and de-provisioning of user access.
  • Collaborate with government stakeholders, security teams, and application owners to define identity governance requirements and translate them into effective SailPoint solutions.
  • Support the design and implementation of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) models, Separation of Duties (SoD) policies, and access certification campaigns.
  • Ensure SailPoint configurations and deployments comply with federal security standards including NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, FedRAMP, and Zero Trust Architecture principles.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex SailPoint platform issues, conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions to minimize service disruptions.
  • Monitor SailPoint system performance, audit logs, and access reports to identify anomalies, compliance gaps, and potential security risks.
  • Support Authority to Operate (ATO) processes and security assessments related to SailPoint platform components.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including architecture designs, integration guides, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Provide technical mentorship and knowledge transfer to junior team members and government stakeholders on SailPoint capabilities and identity governance best practices.
  • Stay current with SailPoint product updates, emerging identity governance trends, and evolving federal ICAM policy requirements.

  • 7+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) or Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and administering SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow in an enterprise environment.
  • Active Secret Clearance required.

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer or SailPoint Certified IdentityNow Engineer certification.
  • SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Architect or equivalent advanced SailPoint certification.
  • Exceptional communication skills in English – both written and oral – with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior government officials.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow, including lifecycle management, access certifications, role management, and provisioning workflows.
  • Strong proficiency in SailPoint development including BeanShell/Java scripting, rules, workflows, and custom connector development.
  • Experience integrating SailPoint with enterprise directory services including Microsoft Active Directory and Azure Active Directory.
  • Proficiency in identity federation and provisioning protocols including SAML 2.0, OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SCIM.
  • Strong understanding of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) concepts including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Separation of Duties (SoD), and access lifecycle management.
  • Working knowledge of federal ICAM frameworks including FICAM, NIST SP 800-63, and OMB identity-related memoranda.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust Architecture principles and their application to identity governance programs.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks including NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and FedRAMP compliance requirements.
  • Experience supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) processes and contributing to System Security Plans (SSPs) related to identity governance platforms.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex identity governance issues across integrated enterprise systems and applications.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including architecture diagrams, integration specifications, and operational runbooks.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment, effectively managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven setting.
  • Active Secret Clearance.

Desired Skills and Competencies:

  • Experience working in a federal government or Department of Defense (DoD) IT environment.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, (OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor)
jobs.excerpt: Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week Check out this Loom video for more details: We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

jobs.description:
Engineering Manager

Pathstream | Engineering | Remote

ROLE / DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

Pathstream is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead one of our engineering pods, a team of 4+ engineers building and maintaining the platform that powers our learning and workforce-development products. This is a people management role reporting to the SVP of Engineering: you will own the growth, performance, and effectiveness of your team, while staying technical enough to set direction within your domain, drive delivery of broadly scoped initiatives, and hold a high bar on quality.

We are looking for someone who has built a strong foundation as an engineer, highly proficient in one or more technical areas, and is now energized by multiplying their impact through others. Growing the engineers on their team, owning their team's roadmap, and turning company strategy into well-sequenced, well-executed engineering work.

A core expectation of this role is to champion Pathstream's AI-native engineering practices within your team. AI adoption is already deeply embedded in how we build software at Pathstream. We are looking for a manager who actively drives the effective and responsible adoption of AI-enabled development tools on their team, and who coaches engineers to get real leverage from them.

WHAT WE DO

Pathstream was founded on the premise that substantial unrealized economic and human potential exists within each organization's frontline workforce. We are reshaping the way employees and managers on the frontlines excel in their careers. In this age of rapid tech evolution, our enterprise partnerships transform frontline teams from transactional to relational, and from task-oriented to strategic.

We impact companies' bottom lines with improved productivity, increased retention, and differentiated quality of customer experience — while employees experience greater success in their current roles and unlock future professional growth.

We're a tight-knit, hardworking, mission-driven team of ~60 employees eager to scale our solution and transform careers across the United States.

THE ROLE

PEOPLE LEADERSHIP & TEAM CRAFT

  • Directly manage a team of 4+ engineers. Own their growth and performance end-to-end — regular 1:1s, growth plans, performance reviews, compensation recommendations, and timely, candid feedback. Run performance cycles in partnership with your manager, navigating the most sensitive situations with support from senior leadership.
  • Own hiring for your team. Partner with recruiting to scope roles, run interview loops, and play a central role in evaluating engineering candidates and shaping hiring decisions. Build a team with clear roles, healthy collaboration patterns, and strong engagement, and take ownership of improving the experience of more junior members of the team.
  • Deliver feedback proactively and partner on solutions. Offer timely, unprompted feedback that integrates new context as it emerges, co-create next steps with the recipient, and know when escalation is appropriate.
  • Develop engineering talent. Demonstrate success in growing engineers, and establish formal mentoring relationships with more junior engineers — through pairing, design feedback, and code review.
  • Be a steadying force and a positive influence. Provide team stability through priority and business shifts, bring everyone into the conversation, advocate for the growth and success of others, and publicly celebrate the achievements of your teammates.

TECHNICAL DIRECTION & EXECUTION

  • Define and own your team's roadmap and technical direction. Influence team priorities to match business objectives, lead service-level planning and technical strategy discussions, and translate company strategy into sequenced, well-scoped engineering work.
  • Own planning and prioritization for large initiatives. In partnership with leadership, estimate and manage timelines and risk, define success criteria, bring teammates along throughout the planning process, and sequence work so it can be spread efficiently across multiple people.
  • Guide your team through ambiguous, broadly scoped work — major refactors, new services, and other impactful changes — driving end-to-end resolution of complex problems by drawing on both established and new techniques.
  • Maintain strong technical proficiency. Stay highly proficient in one or more technical areas and effective across a wide range, with a deep enough understanding of your team's systems to contribute across its entire domain of ownership. Take ownership of transferring knowledge to less-experienced teammates to support scalability and reduce single points of failure.
  • Hold a high quality bar. Identify where code structure and architecture can be improved for testability and maintainability and bring well-formed proposals to the team. Provide thorough, constructive code review that goes beyond functionality to how code should be structured for future reliability and maintainability.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs. Make sound, informed decisions about technical debt and velocity, and proactively call out when a plan must change mid-project, recommending a new approach based on current priorities.
  • Ensure technical documentation accounts for stability, performance, scalability, and business needs, and review your team's documents constructively without being nitpicky.

AI & AGENTIC ENGINEERING LEADERSHIP

  • Champion AI-native engineering on your team. Ensure your engineers are adopting AI-enabled development tools (Claude Code) effectively and responsibly, in line with Pathstream's internal AI guardrails.
  • Coach your team on how to collaborate well with AI systems, when to use which tool, and how to evaluate AI-generated output.
  • Embrace change introduced by evolving technology. Partner with engineering leadership to roll out and refine AI tooling, workflows, and standards across the org, and help your team turn new capabilities into real, measurable leverage.
  • Stay hands-on enough to be credible. You use these tools in your own work and can speak from practical experience about what works, what doesn't, and why.

PLATFORM HEALTH, SECURITY & OPERATIONS

  • Ensure your team operates production systems well. Participate in on-call, including, with support, code outside your team's normal responsibility and use observability tooling to catch issues before they affect customers.
  • Partner with engineering leadership on security and compliance in your domain, including SOC2, vulnerability management, authentication systems, and the controls that protect Pathstream's enterprise customers and learners.
  • Translate operational pain and on-call insights into roadmap priorities and process improvements, and ensure your team maintains sound DevOps and operational practices across infrastructure, APIs, automation, and deployment pipelines.

ABOUT YOU

EXPERIENCE

  • You bring 4+ years of professional software engineering experience and are highly proficient in one or more technical areas, with the range to be effective across many others.
  • You have 2+ years leading and mentoring engineers — as a team lead, technical lead, or engineering manager — and a demonstrated track record of developing engineering talent.
  • You have owned the technical design and delivery of broadly scoped work end-to-end — a major refactor, a new service, or a comparably impactful initiative — and been independently responsible for the full delivery process in your area.
  • You bring a deep understanding of scalability best practices and experience designing and implementing solutions that can handle significant growth.
  • You bring familiarity with modern web application stacks similar to ours: Ruby on Rails, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Docker, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
  • You understand infrastructure automation, platform security, and DevOps practices, and you are comfortable with the discipline of operating production systems that hold customer data. Practical experience with security and compliance in a SaaS environment (SOC2, vulnerability management, authentication) is a plus.

AI & TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP

  • You are hands-on with modern AI-enabled development tools and agentic engineering approaches and bring genuine enthusiasm and the drive to grow production experience with them quickly.
  • You embrace change introduced by evolving technology, set ambitious goals, and proactively seek feedback on your own areas of growth.
  • You have practical judgment about when AI accelerates engineering work and when it introduces risk, and you can articulate that distinction to your team.

LEADERSHIP & COLLABORATION

  • You lead through influence and trust rather than authority. You are sought out for technical and people feedback because of your thorough, helpful advice and your kind, respectful communication.
  • You communicate with clarity, brevity, and focus, and you are effective in crucial conversations even when they are uncomfortable. You can translate technical concepts into language that is understood and useful across teams, adapting your message for different audiences.
  • You drive discussions with product and other stakeholders that turn ambiguous problem statements into clear engineering requirements, and you work productively through challenging conversations when constraints conflict.
  • You are comfortable operating in environments with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you bring a proactive, data-informed approach to decision-making even when perfect information is unavailable.
  • You bring others along rather than working in a silo. You are a steadying force for your team, you invest deeply in the engineers around you, you celebrate the wins of others, and you treat disagreement as a collaboration tool rather than a contest to win. You see managing a team as the way to multiply your impact.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Transparent and social culture, challenging work, fast learning cycles, practical training, and meaningful feedback
  • Strong sense of ownership and strategic work that impacts our product, users, colleagues, business, and world
  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience and geographic location:
    • Tier 1: $160K–$202K (NYC metro & San Francisco)
    • Tier 2: $144K–$181K
    • Tier 3: $128K–$161K
  • Comprehensive benefits package
    • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and 50% for your partner/spouse and dependents
    • Flexible spending account (health)
    • Employee Assistance Program (mental health, financial health, legal support, and more)
    • Free access to wellbeing apps like Ginger and Headspace
    • Flexible paid time off and 13 paid holidays
    • Generous paid parental leave
    • Short and long-term disability insurance (100% company paid)
    • Annual professional development budget
    • Company-provided laptop
    • Remote-first culture
    • Life insurance (100% company paid)
      • Optional supplemental life insurance
    • 401(k)
    • Discounted pet insurance

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Our company values diversity and believes diverse teams make innovation possible. We work on complex, difficult problems with no linear or clear solutions. We need a diverse team that can bring different perspectives and approaches, and whose experiences reflect the full set of stakeholders we seek to serve. As such, Pathstream is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage all qualified applicants from any race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or other characteristics to apply.

SAN FRANCISCO FAIR CHANCE ORDINANCE

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Join Samsara's In-Vehicle Experience team as a Senior Software Engineer. You'll be the technical leader of the team, setting the direction for what we build and how. We are building AI voice experiences that speak to, coach, and assist drivers as they work, spanning proactive assistance, on-demand interaction, and the range of situations in between. We are looking for the product-minded full-stack engineer who will figure out what those experiences should be, ship them, and build the systems that let them evolve into one coherent product rather than a set of disconnected tools.

You'll design what agents say and how they behave, build the services that support them, and iterate on both based on what drivers actually experience. These systems sit at the intersection of software, AI, and the physical world. Because drivers interact with our products while operating a vehicle, decisions about what reaches them, and when, carry real weight. The systems underneath are where the hard-to-reverse decisions live. How agents share context, how concurrent interactions get arbitrated, and how the system's decisions can be explained after the fact. You'll decide what's worth building, and own the systems that make it possible.

You'll ship against clear priorities from day one. We are looking for someone whose instinct is to shape the direction of the team's work, not just execute against it. Putting forward a point of view, making the case for it, and getting the team moving in a new direction is core to how this person operates. Engineers who habitually notice what should improve and then make it happen, rather than waiting to be told, will find this kind of role familiar.

AI-assisted engineering is central to this role. You will be expected to use tools such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor proficiently throughout the software development lifecycle, not only for code generation but also for investigation, design, testing, review, and operational work.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada.

In this role, you will:

  • Define what to build and how to build it, shaping product direction from the engineering side.
  • Build and ship voice agent experiences from zero to one in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. Iterate quickly based on real interactions.
  • Own the technical direction for how these experiences coordinate: how they share context, how concurrent interactions get arbitrated, how the system holds up as more experiences are added, and how its real-time decisions can be investigated by the teams that need to.
  • Make and document architectural tradeoffs where requirements are still evolving, favoring foundations that generalize as new use cases emerge over one-off solutions that don't.
  • Serve as the team's technical anchor: review designs, unblock decisions, and mentor engineers as they expand into unfamiliar technical domains.
  • Introduce new patterns for full-stack and AI-assisted engineering, and get the team using them.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of products from concept through production.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Recent, primary experience shipping LLM/agent based products end-to-end, including evaluation of AI behavior in production.
  • Experience with memory, context, or retrieval systems for AI applications (e.g., RAG pipelines, vector databases, long-lived session context).
  • Strong programming and design fundamentals (Go, TypeScript, Python).
  • Experience designing APIs and service boundaries that other systems rely on.
  • Experience setting technical direction on a team and mentoring other engineers.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical direction without formal authority.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States or Canada (this is a fully remote role).

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building zero-to-one products in fast-moving, high-autonomy environments.
  • Experience building persistent memory or personalization systems where agents learn about users over time.
  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration: coordinating multiple agents, avoiding conflicts, and maintaining consistency.
  • Experience building scheduling or arbitration systems.
  • Experience designing systems that combine structured and open-ended signal collection to inform product decisions.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$142,800—$184,800 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Welo Global is hiring an SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) to bring deep technical rigor to middleware-layer testing. This role requires strong technical expertise across gRPC-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, JSON-RPC/REST, proxy-based traffic inspection, and API scripting. The primary responsibility is to observe and reconstruct the network interactions generated by the onboarding UI, including request/response structures, schemas, headers, identifiers, Enums, and client-injected parameters. This is primarily an API/network analysis and evidence-generation role rather than a conventional UI automation or regression-testing role. The resource will produce sanitized network evidence and controlled, benign tracer replay scripts for downstream backend validation.


Project Details
Title: SDET - API/Middleware
Rate: $9.50/hr
Start Date: 19th October
Duration: 5 Weeks
Commitment: 35 Hours per Week
Location: India (Remote)
Job Type: Freelance

    • Export clean, sanitized HAR/network evidence while maintaining traceability between UI actions and corresponding network requests.

    • Map relevant schemas, headers, identifiers, routing information, and client-injected parameters.

    • Use proxy tools such as Mitmproxy, Charles Proxy, and browser DevTools to inspect, intercept, and validate network traffic between client and server

    • Develop and maintain API automation scripts using Python, Postman, and cURL for functional and regression testing

    • Collaborate with backend and middleware engineers to define testable contracts and edge-case scenarios

    • Continuously improve test automation frameworks for reliability, speed, and maintainability

Required Qualifications

    • Proficiency with proxy/traffic inspection tools including Mitmproxy, Charles Proxy, and browser DevTools

    • Solid scripting/programming skills in Python, with practical use of Postman and cURL for API automation

    • Experience designing and maintaining automated test suites for middleware or API-layer services

    • Working understanding of API request structure, including headers, auth tokens, and internal/system parameters, and how to test for their correct handling

    • Understanding of software engineering practices as applied to test automation (version control, CI integration, code review)

    • Experience analysing browser-generated network traffic and reconstructing API behaviour is strongly preferred.
